character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano firme guía la labor con destreza, sirviendo de (为) orientadora eficaz.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 作为社会的一分子，每个人都在用自己的行动书写历史。无论身处平凡的岗位还是显赫的舞台，只要怀揣善意认真做事，就能为他人带去光明。不因位卑而自弃，不因艰难而退缩，这才是作为一个人最崇高的尊严。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zuòwéi shèhuì de yì fēnzǐ, měi ge rén dōu zài yòng zìjǐ de xíngdòng shūxiě lìshǐ. Wúlùn shēnchǔ píngfán de gǎngwèi háishì xiǎnhè de wǔtái, zhǐyào huáichuāi shànyì rènzhēn zuòshì, jiù néng wèi tārén dàiqù guāngmíng. Bù yīn wèibēi ér zìqì, bù yīn jiānnán ér tuìsuō, zhè cáishì zuòwéi yí ge rén zuì chónggāo de zūnyán.
extended_reading_passages.en: As members of society, all write history with actions. Whether in humble posts or grand stages, acting with goodwill brings light to others. Not abandoning oneself for low status is the highest human dignity.
extended_reading_passages.es: Como miembros de la sociedad, todos forjamos la historia con nuestros actos. Ya sea en un puesto humilde o en un gran escenario, obrar con buena fe alumbra a los demás. No desanimarse ante la dificultad dignifica la condición humana.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在推动生态文明建设的进程中，政府部门必须积极作为。通过建立严格的环境保护问责制度，杜绝个别企业以牺牲绿水青山为代价换取短期经济效益的违法行为。唯有勇于担当作为，才能为子孙后代留下一片天蓝水清的美好家园。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài tuīdòng shēngtài wénmíng jiànshè de jìnchéng zhōng, zhèngfǔ bùmén bìxū jījí zuòwéi. Tōngguò jiànlì yángé de huánjìng bǎohù wènzé zhìdù, dùjué gèbié qǐyè yǐ xīshēng lǜshuǐ-qīngshān wéi dàijià huànqǔ duǎnqī jīngjì xiàoyì de wéifǎ xíngwéi. Wéiyǒu yǒngyú dāndāng zuòwéi, cáinéng wèi zǐsūn-hòudài liúxià yí piàn tiānlán-shuǐqīng de měihǎo jiāyuán.
extended_reading_passages.en: In promoting ecological progress, government bodies must take proactive action. Strict environmental accountability prevents firms from sacrificing nature for short-term gain. Bold initiative ensures clean skies for future generations.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la salvaguarda ecológica, los poderes públicos deben actuar con firmeza. Exigir responsabilidades ambientales frena a las empresas que sacrifican la naturaleza por lucro efímero. Solo asumiendo el deber se legará un entorno limpio a la posteridad.

meanings_summary.en: knowledge; learning; scholarship; erudition; wisdom; knack
meanings_summary.es: conocimiento; saber; erudición; ciencia; arte; sabiduría práctica

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: True knowledge is forged by coupling diligent study (学) with constant inquiring (问) to master deep scholarship (学问).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El verdadero conocimiento nace de aunar el estudio constante (学) con la pregunta incisiva (问) para forjar el saber (学问).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Confucius taught in the Analects that one must 'learn and inquire' (学而问之); true Chinese scholarship rejects passive intake in favor of persistent philosophical questioning.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising tone followed by neutral tone: 'xué wen' (35-2). Syllable 'xué' glides upward, while 'wen' is pronounced as a light neutral syllable.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 学问 denotes systematic erudition, profound scholarship, or the intricate wisdom embedded in craft techniques.

contrasts.analysis: 知识 refers to discrete informational facts and data, whereas 学问 implies deep, integrated, lifelong scholarship and philosophical insight.
学术 refers strictly to formal institutional university research and scientific theory, while 学问 can also describe practical knacks in daily life ('泡茶有学问').
经验 refers to empirical habits gathered through repetition, while 学问 emphasizes reasoned principles and scholarly mastery.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 宀 instead of the upper strokes of 学
Has person 人 inside 门 instead of 口
Has 才 inside 门 instead of 口
Has sun 日 inside 门 instead of 口

etymological_cognates.gloss_en: hear with ear at gate; reputation

senses.definition_en: systematic academic knowledge, deep erudition, or profound intellectual scholarship
senses.definition_es: conocimiento académico sistemático, profunda erudición o sabiduría intelectual
senses.example_phrase: 有高深的学问 (possess profound scholarship)

senses.definition_en: hidden technique, special knack, or practical wisdom embedded in everyday affairs
senses.definition_es: truco especial, secreto técnico o sabiduría práctica oculta en el quehacer cotidiano
senses.example_phrase: 这里面大有学问 (there is a great deal of skill/knack in this)

example_sentences.hanzi: 老教授一生潜心钻研甲骨文，学问渊博品德高尚，受到了海内外学界的一致尊崇。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǎo jiàoshòu yìshēng qiánxīn zuānyán jiǎgǔwén, xuéwen yuānbó pǐndé gāoshàng, shòudào le hǎinèiwài xuéjiè de yízhì zūnchóng.
example_sentences.en: The veteran professor dedicated his life to oracle bone research; his profound learning and noble virtue won universal scholarly respect.
example_sentences.es: El catedrático consagró su vida al desciframiento de los huesos oraculares; su vasta erudición y probidad le valieron gran estima académica.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在鲁迅看来，烹饪选料与饮食调味里处处藏着大学问，懂得品味美食也是体察世情的一种方式。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài Lǔ Xùn kànlái, pēngrèn xuǎnliào yǔ yǐnshí tiáowèi lǐ chùchù cáng zhe dà xuéwen, dǒngdé pǐnwèi měishí yě shì tǐchá shìqíng de yì zhǒng fāngshì.
example_sentences.en: In Lu Xun's eyes, selecting culinary ingredients and seasonings harbored profound wisdom; savoring food was a way to observe life.
example_sentences.es: Para Lu Xun, la elección de ingredientes y el sazón culinario albergaban un profundo saber; saborear delicias era otra forma de entender la vida.

idioms.meaning_en: conversant with both ancient and modern learning
there is no limit to learning; lifelong study
clever and fond of learning
full of political and administrative scholarship

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram showing a child 子 learning arithmetic tallies beneath a thatched classroom roof.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A child (子) under a roof eagerly studies classic texts to acquire lifelong knowledge (学).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un joven estudiante (子) bajo el tejado escolar asimila los libros para cultivar el saber (学).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram showing an open mouth 口 at the gate 门 of a master's courtyard asking for instruction.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A seeker arrives at the teacher's doorway (门) and opens their mouth (口) to inquire and ask (问).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un aprendiz se asoma al portón (门) del sabio y abre la boca (口) para inquirir y preguntar (问).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 真正的学问从不只存在于故纸堆中，它鲜活地流淌在柴米油盐的人间烟火里。无论是木匠手中精准无误的榫卯构造，还是厨师火候中出神入化的调味平衡，只要用心体悟精益求精，平凡琐事之中皆藏着深奥的大学问。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de xuéwen cóng bù zhǐ cúnzài yú gùzhǐduī zhōng, tā xiānhuó de liútǎng zài cháimǐ-yóuyán de rénjiān yānhuǒ lǐ. Wúlùn shì mùjiang shǒuzhōng jīngzhǔn-wúwù de sǔnmǎo gòuzào, háishì chúshī huǒhòu zhōng chūshén-rùhuà de tiáowèi pínghéng, zhǐyào yòngxīn tǐwù jīngyì-qiújīng, píngfán suǒshì zhīzhōng jiē cáng zhe shēn'ào de dà xuéwen.
extended_reading_passages.en: True learning lives not merely in dusty tomes, but flows through daily life. From a carpenter's seamless mortise joints to a chef's balanced seasonings, ordinary tasks harbor profound wisdom if approached with dedication.
extended_reading_passages.es: El saber genuino no habita solo en viejos legajos, sino en las tareas cotidianas. Desde las ensambladuras precisas del carpintero hasta el sazón magistral del cocinero, la búsqueda de la perfección encierra una honda sabiduría.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 求学问之道在于知行合一。先贤倡导博学之、审问之、慎思之、明辨之、笃行之，强调学术研究不能脱离社会现实。学者只有扎根大地洞察民生疾苦，将理论创见转化为解决实际问题的良方，才能成就无愧于时代的大大学问。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Qiú xuéwen zhī dào zàiyú zhīxíng-héyī. Xiānxián chàngdǎo bóxué zhī, shěnwèn zhī, shènsī zhī, míngbiàn zhī, dǔxíng zhī, qiángdiào xuéshù yánjiū bùnéng tuōlí shèhuì xiànshí. Xuézhě zhǐyǒu zhāgēn dàdì dòngchá mínshēng jíkǔ, jiāng lǐlùn chuàngjiàn zhuǎnhuà wéi jiějué shíjì wèntí de liángfāng, cáinéng chéngjiù wúkuì yú shídài de dà xuéwen.
extended_reading_passages.en: The path of scholarship requires unity of knowing and doing. Sages urged wide learning, questioning, thinking, discerning, and practicing. Scholars must ground theories in real life, turning insights into remedies to achieve great scholarship.
extended_reading_passages.es: El camino del saber exige unir conocimiento y acción. Los antiguos exhortaban a estudiar, inquirir, reflexionar y obrar con rectitud. Solo arraigando la teoría en los dilemas reales se forja una ciencia digna de su tiempo.

meanings_summary.en: to be particular about; to pay attention to; exquisite; tasteful; particularity
meanings_summary.es: ser exigente con; cuidar al detalle; refinado; primoroso; esmero; minuciosidad

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Discuss rules with precision (讲) and probe to the deepest cave (究) to ensure everything is exquisite and particular (讲究).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Expón las normas (讲) e indaga hasta el fondo (究) para asegurar que todo sea primoroso y refinado (讲究).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Originates from scholar-official aesthetics where living was elevated into an art form; 'jiǎngjiu' denotes mindful taste and refined restraint rather than vulgar ostentation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping tone followed by neutral tone: 'jiǎng jiu' (214-2). Syllable 'jiǎng' dips fully, and 'jiu' is softened into a light neutral tone.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 讲究 denotes meticulous attention to quality and refined aesthetic standards, or describes tastefully made artifacts.

contrasts.analysis: 注重 is a neutral verb meaning to place emphasis on something, while 讲究 implies refined aesthetic taste, etiquette, or demanding connoisseurship.
精致 is solely an adjective describing finely crafted physical objects, whereas 讲究 can function as verb (to stress), adjective (tasteful), or noun (delicate rule).
挑剔 carries a negative nuance of being fussily hypercritical, whereas 讲究 represents cultured elegance and high standards.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 午 on right instead of 井
Has 犬 below 穴 instead of 九
Has 力 below 穴 instead of 九
Has 工 below 穴 instead of 九

senses.definition_en: to pay meticulous attention to, stress, or be exceptionally discerning and particular about quality or etiquette
senses.definition_es: prestar minuciosa atención a, ser sumamente exigente con o cuidar con esmero la calidad o el protocolo
senses.example_phrase: 讲究卫生 (pay attention to hygiene)

senses.definition_en: tasteful, exquisite, sophisticated, or delicately made
senses.definition_es: primoroso, refinado, elegante o primorosamente elaborado
senses.example_phrase: 陈设很讲究 (furnishings are very tasteful)

senses.definition_en: intricate rules, delicate techniques, or fine points to be observed
senses.definition_es: reglas sutiles, detalles protocolarios o pormenores a tener en cuenta
senses.example_phrase: 很有讲究 (involves a great deal of fine points)

example_sentences.hanzi: 这间茶室的布置极为讲究，无论是几案上的宋瓷插花还是墙上的古画，都透出淡雅的文人趣味。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiān cháchì de bùzhì jíwéi jiǎngjiu, wúlùn shì jī'àn shàng de Sòng cí chāhuā háishì qiáng shàng de gǔhuà, dōu tòuchū dànyǎ de wénrén qùwèi.
example_sentences.en: The decor of this teahouse is extremely exquisite; whether the Song porcelain flower arrangement or antique scrolls, it exudes literati elegance.
example_sentences.es: La decoración de este salón de té es primorosa; tanto los jarrones de porcelana Song como las pinturas murales respiran refinamiento letrado.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅先生对饮食极为讲究，不仅挑选食材严苛，更对火候掌控与菜肴搭配有着极高的美学追求。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn xiānsheng duì yǐnshí jíwéi jiǎngjiu, bùjǐn tiāoxuǎn shícái yánkē, gèng duì huǒhou zhǎngkòng yǔ càiyáo dāpèi yǒuzhe jí gāo de měixué zhuīqiú.
example_sentences.en: Mr. Lu Xun was extremely particular about dining; he not only selected ingredients rigorously, but held high aesthetic standards for cooking heat and pairings.
example_sentences.es: Lu Xun era muy exigente con la comida; no solo seleccionaba los ingredientes con rigor, sino que cuidaba al detalle el fuego y la armonía de los platos.

collocations.en: be particular about food and clothing

idioms.meaning_en: constantly strive for ever greater perfection
scrupulously meticulous; not overlooking a single thread
nitpick and blow aside hair looking for tiny flaws
reach the pinnacle of excellence

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where speech 讠 is structured in an orderly grid 井, meaning to discuss and stress rules.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Orderly words (讠) laid out like a neat square water well (井) explain instructions carefully (讲).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Palabras claras (讠) ordenadas como el brocal de un pozo (井) exponen las normas con rigor (讲).

character_decomposition.meaning_es: indagar; examinar a fondo; al fin
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram showing probing to the ninth 九 extreme depth of a cave 穴, meaning exhaustive scrutiny.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Probing deep into a dark cave (穴) nine (九) times leaves no stone unturned in thorough research (究).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Explorar el fondo de la caverna (穴) hasta el límite nueve (九) no deja rincón sin escrutar (究).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 生活里的讲究，不是挥金如土的奢侈，而是一种取悦内心的自律与从容。清晨给花瓶换上一束带露的雏菊，沏茶时严格把握水温，这些看似繁琐的细节，正是让平淡日子开出花来的秘诀。讲究，是把平凡日子过成诗意。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shēnghuó lǐ de jiǎngjiu, bú shì huījīn-rútǔ de shěchǐ, ér shì yì zhǒng qǔyuè nèixīn de zìlǜ yǔ cóngróng. Qīngchén gěi huāpíng huànshàng yí shù dài lù de chújú, qīchá shí yángé bǎwò shuǐwēn, zhèxiē kànsì fánsuǒ de xìjié, zhèng shì ràng píngdàn rìzi kāichū huā lái de mìjué. Jiǎngjiu, shì bǎ píngfán rìzi guò chéng shīyì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Being particular about life is not squandering money, but self-discipline and tranquility that pleases the soul. Replacing daisies with morning dew or controlling tea water temperature turns ordinary days into poetic moments.
extended_reading_passages.es: El esmero cotidiano no es derroche, sino templanza y deleite interior. Poner margaritas frescas al alba o cuidar la temperatura del agua al preparar té son detalles que hacen florecer la rutina, convirtiendo lo ordinario en poesía.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统建筑对营造法式有着极其严苛的讲究。从梁架榫卯的咬合精度，到斗拱排布的力学结构，无不体现出古代匠人对天人合一哲学思想的崇高追求。这种对工艺极致讲究的工匠精神，正是中华传统营建文脉生生不息的根基。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng jiànzhù duì yíngzào fǎshì yǒuzhe jíqí yánkē de jiǎngjiu. Cóng liángjià sǔnmǎo de yǎohé jīngdù, dào dǒugǒng páibù de lìxué jiégòu, wúbù tǐxiàn chū gǔdài jiàngrén duì tiānrén-héyī zhéxué sīxiǎng de chónggāo zhuīqiú. Zhè zhǒng duì gōngyì jízhì jiǎngjiu de gōngjiàng jīngshén, zhèng shì Zhōnghuá chuántǒng yíngjiàn wénmài shēngshēng-bùxī de gēnjī.
extended_reading_passages.en: Traditional Chinese architecture enforces rigorous standards. From mortise precision to bracket mechanics, it reflects harmony between humanity and nature. This relentless commitment to craft excellence forms the foundation of architectural heritage.
extended_reading_passages.es: La arquitectura tradicional china sigue pautas de construcción muy exigentes. Desde el ajuste de las vigas hasta los soportes ménsula, todo refleja la unión del hombre y el cosmos. Ese primoroso rigor artesanal sustenta la memoria edilicia.

meanings_summary.en: average; mean; equally; evenly divided; on average
meanings_summary.es: promedio; medio; por término medio; igualar; equitativo; parejo

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Level the scales (平) and distribute the soil evenly (均) to establish a fair average (平均).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Nivela la balanza (平) y reparte la tierra por igual (均) para calcular el promedio (平均).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from ancient agrarian land surveying (井田制) and balance scales; represents the Confucian value of egalitarian fairness and mathematical equilibrium.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising tone followed by level high tone: 'píng jūn' (35-55). Smooth upward rise on 'píng', followed by a sustained high tone on 'jūn'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 平均 emphasizes mathematical arithmetic mean or dividing an aggregate equally across parts.

contrasts.analysis: 平等 denotes political, legal, and human rights equality, while 平均 refers to mathematical quantities, statistical averages, or physical distribution.
均匀 describes spatial, temporal, or density consistency ('搅拌均匀', stir evenly), whereas 平均 emphasizes mathematical division or mean values.
平常 means ordinary, commonplace, or routine, while 平均 denotes quantitative calculation.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has curved slant at top instead of flat horizontal line of 平
Lacks the earth radical 土 on the left of 均
Has metal radical 钅 on left instead of 土
Vertical stroke crosses top stroke, unlike 平

etymological_cognates.gloss_en: aligned; even like ear of wheat

senses.definition_en: equally distributed without bias, or representing an arithmetic mean
senses.definition_es: distribuido a partes iguales o que representa una media aritmética
senses.example_phrase: 平均分配 (distribute equally)

senses.definition_en: on average; evenly across units of time or count
senses.definition_es: por término medio; de manera uniforme por unidad de tiempo o cuenta
senses.example_phrase: 平均每月 (on average each month)

example_sentences.hanzi: 根据气象台的统计数据，该地区年平均气温在十五摄氏度左右，气候十分宜人舒适。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gēnjù qìxiàngtái de tǒngjì shùjù, gāi dìqū nián píngjūn qìwēn zài shíwǔ shèshìdù zuǒyòu, qìhòu shífēn yírén shūshì.
example_sentences.en: According to meteorological data, the annual average temperature in this region is around 15 degrees Celsius, very pleasant.
example_sentences.es: Según los registros meteorológicos, la temperatura media anual ronda los quince grados, haciendo el clima muy grato.

example_sentences.hanzi: 查阅鲁迅在北京时期的日记发现，他平均每个月都要同挚友聚餐数次，足迹遍及各大知名餐馆。
example_sentences.pinyin: Cháyuè Lǔ Xùn zài Běijīng shíqī de rìjì fāxiàn, tā píngjūn měi ge yuè dōu yào tóng zhìyǒu jùcān shù cì, zújì biànjí gèdà zhīmíng cānguǎn.
example_sentences.en: Reviewing Lu Xun's Beijing diaries reveals that on average he dined out with close friends several times a month across famous restaurants.
example_sentences.es: Al consultar los diarios de Lu Xun en Pekín, se aprecia que por término medio se reunía a comer con amigos íntimos varias veces al mes.

idioms.meaning_en: divide autumn scenery equally; share honors equally
treat everyone equally with same benevolence

idioms.pinyin: bú huàn guǎ ér huàn bù jūn
idioms.meaning_en: worry not about scarcity, but about unequal distribution
when the water rises, the boat goes up too; tied fortunes

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram showing breath dispersing evenly to both sides along a level balance beam.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A balanced scale rests level across the center bar, weighing both pans in fair equality (平).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una balanza de platillos se mantiene nivelada sobre el fiel, repartiendo el peso con equidad (平).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where land 土 is apportioned evenly 匀 among farmers.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Mounds of fertile soil (土) are divided evenly and uniformly (匀) among the field hands (均).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Parcelas de tierra (土) se reparten de modo equitativo (匀) entre los campesinos (均).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 生活的美好从不取决于平均分配的物质多寡，而在于感知幸福的心灵敏感度。同样是面对清风明月，有人视若无睹终日愁容满面，有人却能在粗茶淡饭中自得其乐。学会抚平内心的浮躁，生活才能展现出它温润柔和的原色。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shēnghuó de měihǎo cóng bù qǔjué yú píngjūn fēnpèi de wùzhì duōguǎ, ér zàiyú gǎnzhī xìngfú de xīnlíng mǐngǎndù. Tóngyàng shì miànduì qīngfēng-míngyuè, yǒurén shìruò-wúdǔ zhōngrì chóuróng-mǎnmiàn, yǒurén què néng zài chūchá-dànfàn zhōng zìdé-qílè. Xuéhuì fǔpíng nèixīn de fúzào, shēnghuó cáinéng zhǎnxiàn chū tā wēnrùn róuhé de yuánsè.
extended_reading_passages.en: Life's beauty depends not on equally divided material wealth, but the soul's sensitivity to joy. Facing the breeze and moon, some fret while others find peace in simple meals. Calming inner restlessness reveals life's gentle colors.
extended_reading_passages.es: La gracia de vivir no estriba en repartir bienes por igual, sino en abrir el corazón al gozo. Ante la luna y la brisa, unos viven pesarosos mientras otros hallan paz en la sencillez. Al serenar el ánimo, la vida revela su dulzura natural.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随着公共卫生体系的持续健全，全国人均预期寿命已突破七十八岁大关。这一显著提升的平均数字背后，凝聚着基层医疗资源的均衡覆盖与重大疾病防治能力的全面跃升，切实保障了最广大人民群众最基本的健康权益。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suízhe gōnggòng wèishēng tǐxì de chíxù jiànquán, quánguó rénjūn yùqī shòumìng yǐ tūpò qīshíbā suì dàguān. Zhè yí xiǎnzhù tíshēng de píngjūn shùzì bèihòu, níngjù zhe jīcéng yīliáo zīyuán de jūnhéng fùgài yǔ zhòngdà jíbìng fángzhì nénglì de quánmiàn yuèshēng, qièshí bǎozhàng le zuì guǎngdà rénmín qúnzhòng zuì jīběn de jiànkāng quányì.
extended_reading_passages.en: With public healthcare improving, average national life expectancy has surpassed 78 years. Behind this rising average figure lies balanced primary care coverage and disease prevention, safeguarding foundational health rights.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con el afianzamiento sanitario, la esperanza media de vida ha superado los 78 años. Tras este promedio en alza se aúnan la cobertura equitativa de ambulatorios y la lucha contra dolencias graves, amparando el bienestar colectivo.

meanings_summary.en: hutong; traditional narrow lane or alleyway (especially in Beijing)
meanings_summary.es: hutong; callejón tradicional estrecho (especialmente en Pekín)

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Northern travelers (胡) gathered together in agreement (同) around water-well settlements, giving birth to the hutong (胡同).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Los pobladores del norte (胡) se agrupaban juntos (同) junto a los pozos de agua, creando el callejón hutong (胡同).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Linguistically derived from Mongolian 'hottog' (water well) during the Yuan Dynasty (Dadu / Beijing); settlements clustered around wells became narrow communal alleys.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising tone followed by falling tone or neutral tone: 'hú tòng' (35-51 or 35-2 in Beijing dialect). Syllable 'tòng' drops firmly, often lightened in vernacular speech.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 胡同 specifically denotes traditional northern Chinese residential alleys bordered by grey-brick courtyard walls.

contrasts.analysis: 街道 refers broadly to paved city traffic streets with motor vehicles, whereas 胡同 refers to intimate residential alleys formed by courtyard walls.
胡同 is the northern (Beijing) cultural term for lanes, while 弄堂 (or 里弄) specifically describes Shanghai and southern alleyways.
小巷 is a generic, literary term for any narrow passage in any city, while 胡同 carries specific historical identity tied to Yuan, Ming, and Qing Beijing.

Has water radical 氵 on left of 同
Has 土 at top instead of flat 一

senses.definition_en: traditional narrow street, lane, or alley formed by lines of siheyuan courtyards in northern Chinese cities
senses.definition_es: callejuela o callejón tradicional flanqueado por casas con patio (siheyuan) típico de ciudades norteñas
senses.example_phrase: 穿过狭窄的胡同 (walk through a narrow hutong)

example_sentences.hanzi: 老北京的胡同曲径通幽，灰瓦四合院门前的大槐树下，几位老人正摇着蒲扇悠闲地下着象棋。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Běijīng de hútòng qūjìng-tōngyōu, huīwǎ sìhéyuàn ménqián de dà huáishù xià, jǐ wèi lǎorén zhèng yáo zhe púshàn yōuxián de xià zhe xiàngqí.
example_sentences.en: Old Beijing hutongs wind quietly; under the locust tree before grey-tiled courtyards, elders wave cattail fans, playing chess leisurely.
example_sentences.es: Los callejones del viejo Pekín serpentean apacibles; bajo las acacias ante patios señoriales, los ancianos juegan ajedrez con su abanico.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅在北京生活了十四年，曾先后居住在南半截胡同的会馆与西三条胡同的四合院，留下了无数文学名篇。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn zài Běijīng shēnghuó le shísì nián, céng xiānhòu jūzhù zài Nánbànjié Hútòng de huìguǎn yǔ Xīsāntiáo Hútòng de sìhéyuàn, liúxià le wúshù wénxué míngpiān.
example_sentences.en: Lu Xun lived in Beijing for 14 years, residing in Nanbanjie Hutong guild and Xisantiao courtyard, authoring countless literary masterworks.
example_sentences.es: Lu Xun residió 14 años en Pekín, viviendo en el callejón Nanbanjie y en el patio de Xisantiao, donde redactó célebres páginas literarias.

spacious mansion with secluded inner courtyards
street gossip and alley discussions
have no way out; reach a dead end

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character showing dewlap flesh 月 of oxen; loan character transcribing Mongolian 'hottog' (water well).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Ancient elders (古) stroke their long beards (月) while resting near northern water wells (胡).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Ancianos (古) acarician sus largas barbas (月) junto a los pozos norteños de agua (胡).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram showing people speaking with one unified voice under an enclosure; used as phonetic loan for lane in hutong.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Neighbors gather together under one enclosure (冂) to speak with one mouth (口) along the shared alley (同).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Los vecinos se congregan bajo un mismo techo (冂) hablando a una sola voz (口) en el callejón común (同).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 老北京的魂，大半凝固在错落有致的胡同里。斑驳的朱漆大门，门口蹲坐着威武的石狮，门墩上雕刻着吉祥的花草纹样。傍晚时分炊烟渐起，一声清脆悠长的鸽哨掠过瓦檐，那是深宅大院里最富有人情味的天伦图景。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Lǎo Běijīng de hún, dàbàn nínggù zài cuòluò-yǒuzhì de hútòng lǐ. Bānbó de zhūqī dàmén, ménkǒu dūnzuò zhe wēiwǔ de shíshī, méndūn shàng diāokè zhe jíxiáng de huācǎo wényàng. Bàngwǎn shífēn chuīyān jiàn qǐ, yì shēng qīngcuì yōucháng de gēshào lüèguò wǎyán, nà shì shēnzhái-dàyuàn lǐ zuì fùyǒu rénqíngwèi de tiānlún tújǐng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Old Beijing's soul is set in winding hutongs. Peeling vermilion gates flanked by stone lions and auspicious carvings welcome evening hearth smoke. A crisp pigeon whistle grazes tile eaves, painting a scene rich with human warmth.
extended_reading_passages.es: El alma de Pekín reposa en sus callejones. Portones bermejos flanqueados por leones de piedra guardan el humo de las cocinas al atardecer. El silbido de las palomas surca los tejados, dibujando una estampa entrañable de convivencia.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代城市更新与历史文化名城保护的交汇点上，胡同肌理的修复成了关键课题。市政规划者摒弃大拆大建的粗暴模式，转而推行渐进式的“微循环”改造。在保留原住民市井记忆的同时，完善供暖排污管网，让古老胡同焕发出现代宜居生机。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài chéngshì gēngxīn yǔ lìshǐ wénhuà míngchéng bǎohù de jiāohuìdiǎn shàng, hútòng jīlǐ de xiūfù chéng le guānjiàn kètí. Shìzhèng guīhuàzhě bǐngqì dàchāi-dàjiàn de cūbào móshì, zhuǎn'ér tuīxíng jiànjìnxìng de 'wēixúnhuán' gǎizào. Zài bǎoliú yuánzhùmín shìjǐng jìyì de tóngshí, wánshàn gōngnuǎn páiwū guǎnwǎng, ràng gǔlǎo hútòng huànfā chū xiàndài yíjū shēngjī.
extended_reading_passages.en: Preserving historical cities makes hutong restoration pivotal. Planners abandon demolition for organic micro-renovation. Preserving resident memories while modernizing heating and drainage breathes livable vitality into ancient alleys.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la renovación urbana, la restauración de los hutongs es crucial. Los urbanistas rechazan el derribo masivo y optan por mejoras graduales. Al renovar saneamientos y calefacción sin desalojar vecinos, los viejos callejones cobran nueva vida.

meanings_summary.en: to be located at / in; to lie; to be situated in
meanings_summary.es: situarse en; ubicarse en; hallarse en; encontrarse en

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Take an assigned place (位) at a specific geographical coordinate (于) to be located in (位于).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Ocupa un sitial físico (位) en un punto exacto (于) para hallarte ubicado en (位于).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Combining the spatial noun 'wèi' (seat/post) with the classical locative coverb 'yú' (in/at); standard formal expression in geographic and academic literature.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling tone followed by rising tone: 'wèi yú' (51-35). Crisp descent on 'wèi', followed by a smooth upward glide on 'yú'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 位于 is a formal locative verb indicating precise geographical coordinates or physical orientation.

contrasts.analysis: 在 is the ubiquitous everyday preposition/verb for general presence, whereas 位于 is a formal written verb reserved for geography, buildings, and territories.
位于 denotes static physical/geographic placement ('位于东亚'), whereas 处于 denotes dynamic abstract condition, status, or stage ('处于转型期').
坐落 is poetic and descriptive of buildings resting on landscapes ('坐落于山谷'), while 位于 is objective, factual, and cartographic.

senses.definition_es: ocupar una posición geográfica determinada o hallarse emplazado en un lugar
senses.example_phrase: 位于市中心 (located in the city center)

example_sentences.hanzi: 这座闻名遐迩的历史文化名城位于长江下游平原，水网密布气候温和，自古就是鱼米之乡。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò wénmíng-xiá'ěr de lìshǐ wénhuà míngchéng wèiyú Chángjiāng xiàyóu píngyuán, shuǐwǎng mìbù qìhòu wēnhé, zìgǔ jiùshì yúmǐ-zhīxiāng.
example_sentences.en: This famous historical city is located on the lower Yangtze plain; interlaced with canals and mild, it has been a land of fish and rice since antiquity.
example_sentences.es: Esta célebre urbe histórica se ubica en la llanura del curso bajo del Yangtsé; con clima templado y ríos, ha sido desde siempre emporio de arroz.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅在北京长期居住的故居位于阜成门内宫门口二条，如今已被改建为国家级鲁迅博物馆。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn zài Běijīng chángqī jūzhù de gùjū wèiyú Fùchéngmén nèi Gōngménkǒu èrtiáo, rújīn yǐ bèi gǎijiàn wéi guójiājí Lǔ Xùn Bówùguǎn.
example_sentences.en: Lu Xun's long-term former residence in Beijing is located at Fuchengmen; today it has been renovated into the national Lu Xun Museum.
example_sentences.es: La antigua morada de Lu Xun en Pekín se ubica en el callejón Gongmenkou de Fuchengmen; hoy ha sido convertida en Museo Nacional Lu Xun.

face south with back to the north; ideal orientation
nestled against mountains and beside water

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A respected person (亻) stands tall (立) at their rightful appointed post and seat (位).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona digna (亻) permanece erguida (立) ocupando el puesto y sitial que le corresponde (位).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram showing breath curling forth freely; grammatical preposition denoting location in or at.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El travesaño horizontal sostiene una plomada que señala la ubicación exacta en (于) el mapa.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 位于云贵高原深处的古老村落，千百年来被苍翠的崇山峻岭环抱。奔腾的溪流穿寨而过，青石板路在薄雾中若隐若现。这里没有都市车马的喧嚣，只有晨钟暮鼓与袅袅炊烟，宛如世外桃源般静谧安详，守护着古朴的民风。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wèiyú Yún-Guì gāoyuán shēnchù de gǔlǎo cūnluò, qiānbǎi nián lái bèi cāngcuì de chóngshān-jùnlǐng huánbào. Bēnténg de xīliú chuānzhài-érguò, qīngshíbǎn lù zài báowù zhōng ruòyǐn-ruòxiàn. Zhèlǐ méiyǒu dūshì chēmǎ de xuānxiāo, zhǐyǒu chénzhōng-mùgǔ yǔ niǎoniǎo chuīyān, wǎnrú shìwài-táoyuán bān jìngmì ānxiáng, shǒuhù zhe gǔpǔ de mínfēng.
extended_reading_passages.en: The ancient village located in the Yunnan-Guizhou plateau has been cradled by peaks for millennia. Rushing streams bisect stone paths in mist. Free from urban clamor, morning bells and hearth smoke guard pastoral tranquility.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ubicada en la meseta de Yunnan y Guizhou, la aldea milenaria reposa entre cumbres. El arroyo cruza las veredas de piedra bajo la niebla. Lejos del fragor urbano, las campanas y el humo del hogar custodian la paz rústica.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 位于欧亚大陆十字路口的中亚重镇，自古便是丝绸之路贸易通道上的战略要冲。随着跨境货运班列的常态化开行，这座内陆枢纽城市焕发出勃勃生机，现代物流基地与保税仓储设施拔地而起，有力促进了跨区域多边经贸合作。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wèiyú Ōu-Yà dàlù shízìlùkǒu de Zhōngyà zhòngzhèn, zìgǔ biàn shì Sīchóu zhī Lù màoyì tōngdào shàng de zhànlüè yàochōng. Suízhe kuājìng huòyùn bānliè de chángtàihuà kāixíng, zhè zuò nèilù shūniǔ chéngshì huànfā chū bóbó shēngjī, xiàndài wùliú jīdì yǔ bǎoshuì cāngchǔ shèshī bádì-érqǐ, yǒulì cùjìn le kuà-qūyù duōbiān jīngmào hézuò.
extended_reading_passages.en: A central Asian town located at the Eurasian crossroads has long been a Silk Road bastion. Regular cross-border rail links revive this hub, where logistics parks and bonded warehouses boost multilateral trade.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ubicado en la encrucijada euroasiática, este enclave de Asia Central fue baluarte de la Ruta de la Seda. Gracias al ferrocarril transfronterizo, el nodo renace con almacenes logísticos que impulsan el comercio multilateral.

meanings_summary.en: head; chief; first; leader; measure word for poems, songs, and melodies
meanings_summary.es: cabeza; primero; líder; principal; clasificador para poemas y canciones

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The head (首) sits at the very top of the body, designating the first rank and the measure word for a song (首).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La cabeza (首) corona la cima del cuerpo, simbolizando lo primero y sirviendo de clasificador para canciones (首).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: An anatomical radical in Kangxi lexicography; bodily primacy of the head gave rise to political leadership (首领, 元首) and numerical commencement (首先, 首席).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone: 'shǒu' (214). Pronounce with an articulate dipping and rising tone contour without rushing.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 首 designates the foremost position, head rank, or functions as a classical measure word for poems/songs.

contrasts.analysis: 头 is the common everyday colloquial word for physical head, while 首 is elevated, formal, and poetic ('昂首', '元首').
曲 is a measure word restricted solely to musical tunes and melodies ('一曲梁祝'), while 首 applies to both poems and lyrics.
第一 is a general ordinal number (first), whereas 首 combines ordinal priority with chief executive status ('首席').

senses.definition_es: cabeza física, o máxima autoridad y líder de una comitiva o estado

example_sentences.hanzi: 晚会上，音乐家深情弹唱了一首脍炙人口的经典老歌，唤起了现场观众无尽的美好回忆。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wǎnhuì shàng, yīnyuèjiā shēnqíng tánchàng le yì shǒu kuàizhì-rénkǒu de jīngdiǎn lǎogē, huànqǐ le xiànchǎng guānzhòng wújìn de měihǎo huíyì.
example_sentences.en: At the gala, the musician passionately sang a beloved classic song, awakening endless fond memories in the audience.
example_sentences.es: En la velada, el músico entonó con emoción una canción clásica inolvidable, despertando bellos recuerdos en los asistentes.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅先生发表的《狂人日记》是中国现代文学史上第一篇白话短篇小说，堪称新文学运动的首发之作。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn xiānsheng fābiǎo de 《Kuángrén Rìjì》 shì Zhōngguó xiàndài wénxué shǐ shàng dì yī piān báihuà duǎnpiān xiǎoshuō, kānchēng xīn wénxué yùndòng de shǒufā zhī zuò.
example_sentences.en: Lu Xun's 'Diary of a Madman' was the first vernacular short story in modern Chinese literature, truly the inaugural work of the New Literature movement.
example_sentences.es: El 'Diario de un loco' de Lu Xun fue el primer relato en lengua vernácula de las letras chinas modernas, hito inaugural de la nueva literatura.

idioms.meaning_en: bend the thumb first; second to none; top notch
stride forward proudly with head held high
follow the leader's horse head; follow another's lead
unforeseen from the very beginning

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram depicting a human head with hair 丷 and prominent nose/eye; source of concepts of leadership and beginning.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Wisps of hair (丷) crown the forehead above facial features to represent the vital head and leader (首).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Mechones de pelo (丷) coronan la frente sobre los ojos para representar la cabeza y la primacía (首).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 诗歌是人类心灵最纯粹的低语。在孤独清冷的夜晚，捧读一首直击心灵的哲理诗，那些凝练如金石的字句，瞬间抚平了浮躁与疲惫。好的诗作如同一盏明灯，在漫漫长夜里为疲惫的旅人照亮回归内心的归途。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shīgē shì rénlèi xīnlíng zuì chúncuì de dīyǔ. Zài gūdú qīnglěng de yèwǎn, pěngdú yì shǒu zhíjī-xīnlíng de zhélǐshī, nàxiē níngliàn rú jīnshí de zìjù, shùnjiān fǔpíng le fúzào yǔ píbèi. Hǎo de shīzuò rútóng yì zhǎn míngdēng, zài mànmàn chángyè lǐ wèi píbèi de lǚrén zhàoliàng huíguī nèixīn de guītú.
extended_reading_passages.en: Poetry is the soul's purest whisper. On lonely nights, reading a philosophical poem with words condensed like jade soothes exhaustion. Fine poems are lanterns lighting the traveler's return to peace.
extended_reading_passages.es: La poesía es el susurro más íntimo del alma. En la quietud nocturna, leer un poema que cala hondo disipa la fatiga. Los versos maestros son candiles que alumbran al caminante cansado en su regreso al sosiego interior.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 把保障和改善民生作为经济社会发展的首要任务，是执政为民理念的生动体现。各地政府通过完善多层次社会保障网，将解决好群众关心的就业、教育、医疗等实际问题放在首位，切实提升广大百姓的获得感与安全感。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Bǎ bǎozhàng yǔ gǎishàn mínshēng zuòwéi jīngjì shèhuì fāzhǎn de shǒuyào rènwù, shì zhízhèng-wèimín lǐniàn de shēngdòng tǐxiàn. Gèdì zhèngfǔ tōngguò wánshàn duō céngcì shèhuì bǎozhàng wǎng, jiāng jiějué hǎo qúnzhòng guānxīn de jiùyè, jiàoyù, yīliáo děng shíjì wèntí fàng zài shǒuwèi, qièshí tíshēng guǎngdà bǎixìng de huòdé gǎn yǔ ānquán gǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Making public well-being the primary task of development embodies service to the people. Expanding social security networks prioritizes employment, schooling, and healthcare, enhancing the populace's sense of security.
extended_reading_passages.es: Priorizar el bienestar ciudadano como tarea primordial traduce el compromiso social en hechos. Al afianzar la seguridad social y atender empleo, salud y educación, los gobiernos fortalecen la certidumbre colectiva.

meanings_summary.en: luxurious; lavish; sumptuous; opulent; splendid
meanings_summary.es: lujoso; suntuoso; fastuoso; opulento; de gran lujo

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Heroic bold power (豪) paired with radiant flowering splendor (华) creates magnificent luxury (豪华).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El porte señorial (豪) sumado al esplendor florido (华) engendra el mayor lujo (豪华).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical descriptions of high aristocratic life; 'háo' denoted noble chivalric wealth and 'huá' denoted resplendent ornamentation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two rising tones: 'háo huá' (35-35). Smooth parallel rising pitch contours from mid to high.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 豪华 describes extravagant, highly expensive, and lavishly appointed environments, vehicles, or lineups.

contrasts.analysis: 奢华 carries a stronger flavor of ostentatious, wasteful private indulgence, while 豪华 can describe positive world-class hotel or theater amenities.
雄伟 emphasizes grand physical scale and imposing mountain/architectural stature, while 豪华 stresses high monetary cost and plush interior fittings.
考究 emphasizes refined, meticulous craftsmanship and connoisseur taste, whereas 豪华 emphasizes sheer opulence and scale.

Has 毛 at bottom instead of 豕
Has 比 at top instead of 人 and horizontal strokes
Has 亻 and 匕 side-by-side, unlike 华

senses.definition_en: lavishly decorated, sumptuous, highly expensive, and opulent in appointments or lifestyle
senses.definition_es: decorado con suntuosidad, sumamente costoso, espléndido u opulento en instalaciones o estilo
senses.example_phrase: 豪华酒店 (luxury hotel)

example_sentences.hanzi: 这座豪华的海景度假酒店设施一应俱全，窗外便是碧海银沙，吸引了许多游客前来度假。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò háohuá de hǎijǐng dùjià jiǔdiàn shèshī yìyīng-jùquán, chuāngwài biàn shì bìhǎi-yínshā, xīyǐn le xǔduō yóukè qiánlái dùjià.
example_sentences.en: This luxurious oceanfront resort hotel is fully appointed; with azure sea and white sand outside, it attracts numerous holidaymakers.
example_sentences.es: Este lujoso complejo turístico frente al mar cuenta con todos los servicios; sus vistas de arena y agua turquesa atraen a muchos viajeros.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅常去的北京广和居饭馆虽然称不上豪华，但菜肴风味地道，极适合好友促膝畅谈。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn cháng qù de Běijīng Guǎnghéjū fànguǎn suīrán chēngbùshàng háohuá, dàn càiyáo fēngwèi dìdao, jí shìhé hǎoyǒu cùxī-chàngtán.
example_sentences.en: Although Guangheju restaurant where Lu Xun dined could hardly be called luxurious, its authentic flavors were perfect for intimate talks.
example_sentences.es: Aunque el mesón Guangheju que Lu Xun frecuentaba no era lujoso, su sazón castizo era idóneo para largas sobremesas de amigos.

resplendent with gold and jade luster; glittering
magnificent jade halls in fairy realm
simple and unadorned; plain and genuine

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram showing a wild boar 豕 with formidable bristling spines, symbolizing unrestrained heroic grandeur.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A majestic leader stands tall (高) alongside mighty guardian assets (豕), exuding noble boldness (豪).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un prócer eminente se alza alto (高) protegiendo el vigoroso porcino (豕) con porte magnánimo (豪).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 艸 (flowers blooming in traditional 華)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Traditional 華 depicts abundant radiant tree blossoms; simplified to 华 representing glorious radiance.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Lush branches blossom with vibrant flowers, creating splendid visual magnificence (华).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Ramas lozanas florecen con exhuberancia, creando un espectáculo espléndido y radiante (华).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 真正的富足不在于拥有豪华的豪宅与名车，而在于内心世界的宁静与坦荡。当一个人褪去了对物质奢华的盲目执念，方能在山川草木中领略造化之美，在简朴平淡的生活中品味出最纯粹的幸福。心若丰盈，处处皆胜景。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de fùzú bú zàiyú yǒngyǒu háohuá de háozhái yǔ míngchē, ér zàiyú nèixīn shìjiè de níngjìng yǔ tǎndàng. Dāng yí ge rén tuìqù le duì wùzhì shēhuá de mángmù zhíniàn, fāng néng zài shānchuān-cǎomù zhōng lǐnglüè zàohuà zhī měi, zài jiǎnpǔ píngdàn de shēnghuó zhōng pǐnwèi chū zuì chúncuì de xìngfú. Xīn ruò fēngyíng, chùchù jiē shèngjǐng.
extended_reading_passages.en: True wealth lies not in luxury mansions or cars, but tranquility of the soul. Stripping away blind attachment to opulence allows one to appreciate nature's beauty and taste pure happiness in simplicity. A rich mind finds wonders everywhere.
extended_reading_passages.es: La riqueza cabal no reside en mansiones o coches lujosos, sino en la serenidad de ánimo. Quien se desprende del apego suntuoso descubre la belleza del paisaje y saborea la dicha en lo humilde. Un corazón fecundo halla hermosura en todo rincón.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 近年来，文化消费呈现出从追求豪华排场向注重精神内涵的理性回归。观众不再仅仅为金碧辉煌的舞台布景与豪华明星阵容买单，而是愈发看重艺术剧目的叙事深度与思想张力。这一转变倒逼演艺市场去粗取精，回归创作本体。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jìnniánlái, wénhuà xiāofèi chéngxiàn chū cóng zhuīqiú háohuá páichǎng xiàng zhùzhòng jīngshén nèihán de lǐxìng huíguī. Guānzhòng bù zài jǐnjǐn wèi jīnbì-huīhuáng de wǔtái bùjǐng yǔ háohuá míngxīng zhènróng mǎidān, ér shì yùfā kànzhòng yìshù jùmù de xùshì shēndù yǔ sīxiǎng zhānglì. Zhè yí zhuǎnbiàn dàobī yǎnyì shìchǎng qùcū-qǔjīng, huíguī chuàngzuò běntǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Cultural consumption is returning from lavish spectacles to spiritual substance. Audiences no longer pay just for glittering sets or luxury star casts, but value narrative depth, compelling theaters to focus on core artistic creation.
extended_reading_passages.es: El consumo cultural retorna del fasto escénico a la sustancia intelectual. El público ya no premia decorados dorados o repartos deslumbrantes, sino el calado dramático, empujando a los escenarios a depurar su oferta y volver a la esencia.

meanings_summary.en: to honor with one's presence; to visit; to frequent (polite honorific)
meanings_summary.es: honrar con su presencia; visitar; acudir (fórmula de cortesía)

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Your glorious radiance (光) arrives to illuminate (临) our humble hall, honoring us with your presence (光临).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Tu benévola luz (光) desciende y llega (临) a colmar nuestra casa, honrándonos con tu visita (光临).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical Chinese epistolary and court etiquette; visitors were conceptualized as bringing solar luster ('guānghuī') into an otherwise dark, rustic abode.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Level high tone followed by rising tone: 'guāng lín' (55-35). Hold 'guāng' steadily at high pitch 55, then glide smoothly upward into 2nd tone 'lín'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 光临 is an honorific verb used solely to praise or welcome the arrival of guests, clients, or superiors.

contrasts.analysis: 来到 is a neutral factual verb ('he arrived at the station'), while 光临 is strictly an honorific formula ('welcome your esteemed arrival').
拜访 is spoken by the visitor describing their own respectful visit to another ('我去拜访老师'), while 光临 is spoken by the host to the visitor.
光顾 is used specifically in commercial transactions welcoming patrons to spend money, while 光临 applies broadly to ceremonies, banquets, and homes.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has horizontal crossbar inside bottom legs instead of fire-like top
Has 金 at bottom of 监/临 structures
Has 见 at bottom instead of the right strokes of 临
Has 一 at top instead of left-right division

etymological_cognates.gloss_en: reach; arrive like arrow hitting mark

senses.definition_en: polite honorific expression used by hosts, shops, or institutions welcoming guests or patrons
senses.definition_es: expresión cortés empleada por anfitriones o comercios para agradecer la presencia o llegada de clientes
senses.example_phrase: 欢迎光临 (welcome to our shop/establishment)

example_sentences.hanzi: 画廊开幕典礼上，馆长站在大厅前热情迎接各位艺术界同仁与收藏家的光临指导。
example_sentences.pinyin: Huàláng kāimù diǎnlǐ shàng, guǎnzhǎng zhàn zài dàtīng qián rèqíng yíngjiē gèwèi yìshùjiè tóngrén yǔ shōucángjiā de guānglín zhǐdǎo.
example_sentences.en: At the gallery opening ceremony, the curator stood before the hall welcoming the presence and guidance of art peers and collectors.
example_sentences.es: En la inauguración de la galería, el director aguardaba en el vestíbulo agradeciendo la presencia y las luces de colegas y coleccionistas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 北京宣武门外的那家绍兴餐馆，因鲁迅等知名文人墨客的频繁光临而声名远扬，门庭若市。
example_sentences.pinyin: Běijīng Xuānwǔmén wài de nà jiā Shàoxīng cānguǎn, yīn Lǔ Xùn děng zhīmíng wénrén-mòkè de pínfán guānglín ér shēngmíng yuǎnyáng, méntíng-ruòshì.
example_sentences.en: That Shaoxing diner outside Beijing's Xuanwumen gained renown and bustling patronage due to frequent visits by Lu Xun and prominent writers.
example_sentences.es: Aquel mesón de Shaoxing en Pekín cobró gran fama y bullicio gracias a las asiduas visitas de Lu Xun y célebres literatos.

sweep path to await the arrival of an esteemed guest
reverberate like thunder; renowned name

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram showing a person kneeling with a bright burning torch 火 upon their head, emitting radiance and honor.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A kneeling attendant raises a blazing torch (火) over their head to cast bright light and honor (光) upon visitors.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un criado de rodillas alza una antorcha encendida (火) sobre la cabeza para alumbrar y honrar (光) al forastero.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram showing an official's eye 臣 gazing downward from a height upon subjects below, meaning to arrive from above.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An esteemed noble gaze (臣) turns downward as an honored dignitary arrives and descends (临) into the hall.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La mirada atenta (臣) desciende desde lo alto mientras el ilustre personaje llega y se asoma (临) al salón.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 古人扫径以待远客，一席粗茶便足慰平生。当挚友踏雪而来叩响柴扉，主家满心欢喜相迎，那句发自肺腑的欢迎光临，绝非市井虚辞，而是高山流水般的知音相惜。灯火可亲的庭院里，酒香胜过千言万语。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Gǔrén sǎojìng-yǐdài yuǎnkè, yì xí chūchá biàn zú wèi píngshēng. Dāng zhìyǒu tàxuě-érlái kòuxiǎng cháifēi, zhǔjiā mǎnxīn huānxǐ xiāngyíng, nà jù fāzì-fèifǔ de huānyíng guānglín, juéfēi shìjǐng xūcí, ér shì gāoshān-liúshuǐ bān de zhīyīn xiāngxī. Dēnghuǒ-kěqīn de tíngyuàn lǐ, jiǔxiāng shèngguò qiānyán-wànyǔ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Ancients swept paths awaiting guests; simple tea consoled life. When a dear friend knocks through the snow, welcoming them is no empty commercial greeting, but deep resonance. By warm lamplight, the wine aroma outshines all words.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los antiguos barrían la senda aguardando amigos; un té bastaba para festejar la vida. Cuando el allegado llama a la puerta sobre la nieve, darle la bienvenida no es fórmula hueca, sino complicidad de almas afines al calor de la lumbre.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代高端服务业竞争中，真诚周到的礼仪规范是树立品牌口碑的核心要素。星级酒店与国际航空通过持续优化客户体验，将温馨专业的光临问候融入每一个服务触点，让来自五湖四海的旅客在异乡也能深切感受到宾至如归的尊崇与关怀。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài gāoduān fúwùyè jìngzhēng zhōng, zhēnchéng zhōudào de lǐyí guīfàn shì shùlì pǐnpái kǒubēi de héxīn yàosù. Xīngjí jiǔdiàn yǔ guójì hángkōng tōngguò chíxù yōuhuà kèhù tǐyàn, jiāng wēnxīn zhuānyè de guānglín wènhòu róngrù měi yí ge fúwù chùdiǎn, ràng láizì wǔhú-sìhǎi de lǚkè zài yìxiāng yě néng shēnqiè gǎnshòudào bīnzhì-rúguī de zūnchóng yǔ guānhuái.
extended_reading_passages.en: In high-end hospitality, sincere etiquette builds brand reputation. Luxury hotels integrate professional welcomes into every service touchpoint, allowing travelers from afar to feel the warmth, respect, and belonging of a home away from home.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la hostelería de alto nivel, la cortesía sincera cimenta la reputación. Los hoteles y aerolíneas incorporan una acogida profesional en cada detalle, haciendo que el viajero foráneo experimente la consideración y el calor de sentirse como en casa.

meanings_summary.en: social communication; social interaction; interpersonal contact; to socialize
meanings_summary.es: comunicación social; relaciones interpersonales; trato social; alternar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Cross paths (交) across social boundaries (际) to engage in vibrant social communication (交际).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cruza tus pasos (交) en el punto de encuentro fronterizo (际) para cultivar el trato social (交际).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical Chinese semantics where 'jiāo' represents interpersonal bridge-building and 'jì' represents the interstice or nexus between diverse social actors.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Level high tone followed by falling tone: 'jiāo jì' (55-51). Articulate 'jiāo' on steady pitch 55, then drop cleanly into 4th tone 'jì'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 交际 emphasizes interpersonal networking, social protocol, and communicative competence in public life.

contrasts.analysis: 交流 emphasizes mutual two-way transmission of ideas, culture, or feelings, while 交际 emphasizes broad social networking and interpersonal diplomacy.
社交 is primarily a noun modifier describing social media or society events ('社交平台'), while 交际 focuses on conversational and diplomatic skill.
勾结 has a strongly derogatory meaning of corrupt collusion, while 交际 is neutral and positive.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the upper dot and crossbar 亠 of 交
Has tree radical 木 on left of 交

senses.definition_en: interpersonal communication, social activities, and public networking
senses.definition_es: comunicación interpersonal, relaciones públicas y vida social
senses.example_phrase: 交际能力 (social / interpersonal skills)

senses.definition_en: to socialize with others, network, and engage in mutual relations
senses.definition_es: relacionarse con otros, alternar socialmente y cultivar contactos
senses.example_phrase: 善于交际 (good at socializing)

example_sentences.hanzi: 他在职场中不仅业务精湛，而且极富交际能力，总能妥善处理各部门之间错综复杂的协作关系。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhíchǎng zhōng bùjǐn yèwù jīngzhàn, érqiě jí fù jiāojì nénglì, zǒng néng tuǒshàn chǔlǐ gè bùmén zhījiān cuòzōng-fùzá de xiézuò guānxi.
example_sentences.en: In the workplace, he is not only technically skilled but gifted in interpersonal skills, handling complex cross-department collaboration smoothly.
example_sentences.es: En el trabajo sobresale por su competencia técnica y sus dotes sociales, resolviendo con soltura la colaboración interdepartamental.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅并非不食人间烟火的孤傲斗士，在民国文人圈子里，他宴请同行、以文会友的交际活动十分频繁。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn bìngfēi bùshí-rénjiān-yānhuǒ de gū'ào dòushì, zài Mínguó wénrén quānzi lǐ, tā yànqǐng tóngháng, yǐwén-huìyǒu de jiāojì huódòng shífēn pínfán.
example_sentences.en: Lu Xun was by no means an aloof hermit; in Republican literary circles, his social gatherings hosting peers and making friends were frequent.
example_sentences.es: Lu Xun no fue un ermitaño inaccesible; en los círculos letrados de la República alternaba con frecuencia agasajando colegas y trabando amistad.

idioms.meaning_en: smooth and tactful in all directions; socially adept
gain resources left and right; navigate smoothly
intimate, sworn friendship of complete mutual trust
find each other congenial; shared affinity

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram of a standing human figure with crossed legs, symbolizing mutual exchange, crossing, and friendship.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A friendly figure extends open arms and crosses legs, ready to exchange ideas and make friends (交).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona con las piernas cruzadas extiende los brazos, dispuesta a entablar trato y amistad (交).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Traditional 際 shows an altar 示 at the boundary border 阝 where human earth and divine heaven meet.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Standing at the boundary wall (阝) to present tokens (示) opens doors across border junctures (际).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Junto al muro fronterizo (阝), presentar ofrendas (示) permite tender puentes en el límite (际).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 健康的社交不在于微信列表里有成百上千个好友，而在于交际过程中彼此给予的真诚与温度。真正的交情不需要虚情假意的周旋应酬，而是三两知己围炉夜话时的推心置腹。懂得拒绝无效社交，心灵才能回归丰盈与清宁。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jiànkāng de shèjiāo bú zàiyú Wēixìn lièbiǎo lǐ yǒu chéngbǎi-shàngqiān ge hǎoyǒu, ér zàiyú jiāojì guòchéng zhōng bǐcǐ jǐyǔ de zhēnchéng yǔ wēndù. Zhēnzhèng de jiāoqíng bù xūyào xūqíng-jiǎyì de zhōuxuán yīngchou, ér shì sānliǎng zhījǐ wéilú-yèhuà shí de tuīxīn-zhìfù. Dǒngdé jùjué wúxiào shèjiāo, xīnlíng cáinéng huíguī fēngyíng yǔ qīngníng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Healthy networking lies not in thousands of virtual contacts, but sincerity exchanged. True friendship requires no hypocritical pleasantries, but candid fireside chats with true confidants. Rejecting shallow social noise restores peace.
extended_reading_passages.es: La sana sociabilidad no se mide en listas interminables de contactos, sino en la sinceridad mutua. La amistad verdadera prescinde de cumplidos vanos y prefiere la sobremesa franca al calor del hogar. Filtrar el ruido social devuelve la paz interior.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 跨文化交际能力已成为全球化时代国际复合型人才的必备素养。面对不同国家和民族在价值观与行为范式上的客观差异，青年一代必须学会以开放包容的胸怀倾听对话，在跨文化交际中化解误解偏见，增进不同文明间的互信互鉴。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Kuà wénhuà jiāojì nénglì yǐ chéngwéi quánqiúhuà shídài guójì fùhéxíng réncái de bìbèi sùyǎng. Miànduì bùtóng guójiā yǔ mínzú zài jiàzhíguān yǔ xíngwéi fànshì shàng de kèguān chāyì, qīngnián yídài bìxū xuéhuì yǐ kāifàng bāoróng de xiōnghuái qīngtīng duìhuà, zài kuà wénhuà jiāojì zhōng huàjiě wùjiě piānjiàn, zēngjìn bùtóng wénmíng jiān de hùxìn hùjiàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Cross-cultural communication competence has become essential for global talent. Facing differences in values and norms, youth must listen with an inclusive mindset, dispelling misunderstandings through dialogue to foster mutual civilizational trust.
extended_reading_passages.es: La competencia intercultural es indispensable para el talento globalizado. Ante las divergencias de valores y costumbres, las nuevas generaciones deben dialogar con mente abierta, desvaneciendo prejuicios y cimentando la confianza mutua entre pueblos.

meanings_summary.en: generous; open-handed; natural and poised; tasteful; in good taste
meanings_summary.es: generoso; desprendido; natural; suelto; elegante; de buen gusto

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Possessing a broad, great heart (大) and upright moral poise (方) makes one truly generous and poised (大方).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Tener un corazón magnánimo (大) y modales intachables (方) define a la persona desprendida y elegante (大方).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Originally rooted in the Daoist Zhuangzi phrase 'dàfāng zhī jiā' (大方之家, master of the great cosmic way); over centuries it evolved into a compliment for unselfish generosity and graceful poise.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling tone followed by neutral tone: 'dà fang' (51-2). Articulate 'dà' with a crisp falling 4th tone, letting 'fang' fall into an unstressed neutral tone.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 大方 characterizes unselfish open-handedness with wealth, or natural, unconstrained elegance in posture and dress.

contrasts.analysis: 慷慨 is a literary, elevated adjective specifically emphasizing enthusiastic financial donation or self-sacrifice, while 大方 is broadly used for money, clothes, and natural manner.
小气 (stingy / petty) is the direct antonym of 大方 in both financial generosity and personal magnanimity.
潇洒 emphasizes suave, carefree, dashing charm, while 大方 stresses grounded poise, good taste, and decent generosity.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has extra dot below between legs of 大
Has dot on upper right shoulder of 大
Has no dot at top and right hook instead of vertical
Has slant stroke on top left instead of dot of 方

senses.definition_en: generous and open-handed with money or goods, not stingy or penny-pinching
senses.definition_es: generoso, desprendido y liberal con el dinero o las pertenencias; nada tacaño
senses.example_phrase: 出手很大方 (very generous when spending)

senses.definition_en: natural, poised, and unconstrained in manner and speech; free from awkward self-consciousness
senses.definition_es: desenvuelto, natural y con aplomo en los modales; sin timidez ni afectación
senses.example_phrase: 举止大方 (poised and natural deportment)

senses.definition_en: tasteful, elegant, simple, and not gaudy in visual design or dress
senses.definition_es: elegante, sobrio, de buen tono y no recargado en el vestir o el diseño
senses.example_phrase: 衣着大方 (tastefully dressed)

example_sentences.hanzi: 新来的主持人举止优雅落落大方，在聚光灯前毫不怯场，赢得了全场观众的喝彩。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xīnlái de zhǔchírén jǔzhǐ yōuyǎ luòluò-dàfang, zài jùguāngdēng qián háobù qièchǎng, yíngdé le quánchǎng guānzhòng de hècǎi.
example_sentences.en: The newly arrived presenter was elegant, poised, and perfectly natural, without stage fright under the spotlights, winning applause.
example_sentences.es: La nueva presentadora mostró soltura y porte distinguido, sin amilanarse ante los focos y arrancando los aplausos del público.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅先生为人极其豪爽大方，每逢青年作家囊中羞涩求助，他总是慷慨解囊资助出版与生活。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn xiānsheng wéirén jíqí háoshuǎng dàfang, měiféng niánqīng zuòjiā nángzhōng-xiūsè qiúzhù, tā zǒng shì kāngkǎi-jiěnáng zīzhù chūbǎn yǔ shēnghuó.
example_sentences.en: Mr. Lu Xun was remarkably frank and generous; whenever young struggling writers sought help, he always opened his purse liberally for them.
example_sentences.es: Lu Xun era sumamente desprendido y generoso; cuando jóvenes escritores apurados pedían auxilio, él costeaba sus ediciones y manutención.

idioms.meaning_en: natural, poised, and dignified in conduct
generously untie one's purse to give financial help
become a laughingstock to true experts/masters
poised, dignified, and exquisitely refined

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram of a fully grown human standing with arms and legs outstretched in majestic breadth.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A person stretches arms wide in noble expansiveness, embracing all things in greatness (大).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un hombre abre los brazos de par en par con hidalguía, abarcando el espacio con grandeza (大).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram showing two boats or plows lashed square across; represents proper measure and moral uprightness.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A compass points steadily in all four square directions, guiding conduct along righteous paths (方).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La brújula señala con rectitud los cuatro puntos cardinales, orientando el recto proceder (方).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 做人的最高境界在于大方。对待钱财不斤斤计较，施惠于人而不图回报；与人相处从容坦率，不忸怩作态不卑躬屈膝。这种由内而外生发的大方与舒朗，胜过世间一切矫揉造作的伪装，让人如沐春风倍感踏实。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zuòrén de zuìgāo jìngjiè zàiyú dàfang. Duìdài qiáncái bù jīnjīn-jìjiào, shīhuì yú rén ér bù tú huíbào; yǔ rén xiāngchǔ cóngróng tǎnshuài, bù niǔnī-zuòtài bù bēigōng-qūxī. Zhè zhǒng yóu nèi ér wài shēngfā de dàfang yǔ shūlǎng, shèngguò shìjiān yíqiè jiǎoróu-zàozuò de wěizhuāng, ràng rén rúmù-chūnfēng bèi gǎn tàshí.
extended_reading_passages.en: The highest realm of character is poise and generosity. Not squabbling over pennies, giving without demanding returns, and treating others frankly without servility. This inner magnanimity outshines false pretense like a soothing spring breeze.
extended_reading_passages.es: La mayor nobleza reside en la generosidad y el aplomo. No regatear pequeñeces, brindar ayuda sin esperar paga y tratar al prójimo con soltura sin dobleces. Esa hidalguía que brota del fondo vale más que fingimientos, regalando sosiego.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代极简主义设计强调“简而不陋，素雅大方”。设计师摒弃繁复冗余的雕琢堆砌，通过洗练利落的几何线条与天然材质的质朴肌理，营造出经得起岁月淘洗的空间美感。这种大方得体的审美理念，正深刻引领着当代都市居住风尚。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndài jíjiǎn zhǔyì shèjì qiángdiào 'jiǎn ér bú lòu, sùyǎ dàfang'. Shèjìshī bǐngqì fánfù rǒngyú de diāozhuó duīqì, tōngguò xǐliàn lìluò de jǐhé xiàntiáo yǔ tiānrán cáizhì de zhìpǔ jīlǐ, yíngzào chū jīngdeqǐ suìyuè táoxǐ de kōngjiān měigǎn. Zhè zhǒng dàfang-détǐ de shěnmǐ lǐniàn, zhèng shēnkè yǐnlǐng zhe dāngdài dūshì jūzhù fēngshàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Minimalist design stresses clean elegance: simple yet tasteful. Stripping superfluous ornamentation, designers use crisp lines and natural textures to build timeless spaces. This tasteful aesthetic profoundly guides contemporary urban living.
extended_reading_passages.es: El minimalismo moderno apuesta por la sobriedad distinguida. Al prescindir de barroquismos y valerse de líneas depuradas y materiales puros, se conciben espacios de belleza imperecedera. Ese porte sobrio guía hoy las vanguardias del diseño.

meanings_summary.en: hospitable; friendly to visitors; fond of entertaining guests
meanings_summary.es: hospitalario; acogedor; generoso con las visitas; amante de agasajar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A generous heart that loves (好, hào) to welcome travelers under the roof as guests (客) is truly hospitable (好客).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Quien ama de corazón (好, hào) recibir a viajeros bajo su techo como huéspedes (客) es hospitalario (好客).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical Chinese virtue ethics; in ancient China, hosting traveling scholars and wanderers (养客) was considered the supreme badge of chivalric honor and generosity.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two falling tones: 'hào kè' (51-51). Note the crucial 4th tone on 'hào' (meaning 'to be fond of'); do not pronounce as 3rd tone hǎo.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 好客 specifically characterizes an enthusiastic, warm disposition toward entertaining visitors and treating guests well.

contrasts.analysis: 热情 is a broad personality trait describing general warmth, zeal, or energy in any situation, while 好客 is restricted to receiving guests and travelers.
友善 means amicable and kind to others, whereas 好客 specifically implies opening one's home and table to visitors.
周到 emphasizes thorough, flawless attentiveness in service or protocol, while 好客 emphasizes genuine emotional enthusiasm for guests.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 口 on right instead of 子
Has 谷 below 宀 instead of 各
Has pig 豕 below 宀 instead of 各
Has 女 below 宀 instead of 各

etymological_cognates.gloss_en: friend; companion; two strings of cowries

senses.definition_en: enthusiastic, warm, and generous in receiving, entertaining, and lodging guests
senses.definition_es: cálido, entusiasta y desprendido al recibir, atender y alojar a los visitantes
senses.example_phrase: 热情好客的主人 (warm and hospitable host)

example_sentences.hanzi: 草原上的牧民纯朴好客，每当有远方的客人骑马到来，总会端出喷香的奶茶和手把肉热情款待。
example_sentences.pinyin: Cǎoyuán shàng de mùmín chūnpǔ hàokè, měidāng yǒu yuǎnfāng de kèrén qǐmǎ dàolái, zǒng huì duānchū pēnxiāng de nǎichá hé shǒubàròu rèqíng kuǎndài.
example_sentences.en: Herdsmen on the grassland are simple and hospitable; whenever travelers arrive on horseback, they serve fragrant milk tea and mutton cordially.
example_sentences.es: Los pastores de la estepa son hospitalarios y llanos; al llegar viajeros a caballo, siempre sirven té con leche aromático y carnes asadas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅在北京与上海居住期间极度好客，家中常常高朋满座，同乡挚友与求教青年络绎不绝。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn zài Běijīng yǔ Shànghǎi jūzhù qījiān jídù hàokè, jiā zhōng chángcháng gāopéng-mǎnzuò, tóngxiāng zhìyǒu yǔ qiújiào qīngnián luòyì-bùjué.
example_sentences.en: Lu Xun was exceptionally hospitable in Beijing and Shanghai; his home was constantly filled with distinguished friends and visiting youths.
example_sentences.es: Lu Xun fue un anfitrión entrañable en Pekín y Shanghái; su morada paraba colmada de paisanos, amigos dilectos y jóvenes aprendices.

idioms.meaning_en: empty one's purse to assist a friend in need
a hall full of distinguished and noble guests
return a plum when given a peach; reciprocate mutual goodwill
rush out with shoes on backwards in eager welcome

character_decomposition.meaning_en: be fond of; love; like (4th tone)
character_decomposition.meaning_es: amar; gustar; ser aficionado a (4to tono)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone pictogram showing a loving mother 女 embracing her newborn child 子; pronounced hào when expressing fondness.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A fond mother (女) lovingly cradles her sweet child (子), showing deep affection and love (好).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una madre abnegada (女) abraza a su pequeño (子), reflejando entrañable apego y gusto (好).

character_decomposition.sound_component: 各 (gè, arrival of person from another place)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram showing an individual 各 from another location arriving under the household roof 宀 as a respected guest.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Under the warm roof (宀), travelers from various regions (各) are welcomed as honored guests (客).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Bajo el alero hospitalario (宀), visitantes de diversos confines (各) son acogidos como huéspedes (客).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 山里人天性纯朴好客，哪怕家境并不宽裕，逢有陌生旅人借宿，也总会杀鸡宰鸭拿出最好的存粮款待。围坐在暖融融的柴火堆旁，听着老人讲述山间古老的传说，那种毫无防备的赤诚与善意，足以驱散长途跋涉的所有严寒。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shānlǐ rén tiānxìng chūnpǔ hàokè, nǎpà jiājìng bìng bù kuānyù, féng yǒu mòshēng lǚrén jièsù, yě zǒng huì shājī-zǎiyā ná chū zuì hǎo de cúnliáng kuǎndài. Wéizuò zài nuǎnróngróng de cháihuǒduī páng, tīng zhe lǎorén jiǎngshù shānjiān gǔlǎo de chuánshuō, nà zhǒng háowú-fángbèi de chìchéng yǔ shànyì, zúyǐ qūsàn chángtú bǎshè de suǒyǒu yánhán.
extended_reading_passages.en: Mountain folk are naturally hospitable; even with modest means, when strangers seek shelter they prepare their best provisions. Sitting by the crackling woodfire listening to mountain legends, their warmth dispels all chills of the journey.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los montañeses son hospitalarios por naturaleza; aun con pocos recursos, ante un viajero perdido preparan sus mejores viandas. Al calor del fuego de leña, escuchando viejas leyendas, su generosa calidez disipa el frío del camino.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: “好客中国”不仅是享誉世界的国家旅游名片，更是中华优秀传统文化中“有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎”的当代传承。在各大国际经贸展会与体育盛事中，志愿者们以真诚热忱的好客之礼迎接四海宾朋，向世界生动展现了礼仪之邦的大国风范。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: 'Hàokè Zhōngguó' bùjǐn shì xiǎngyù shìjiè de guójiā lǚyóu míngpiàn, gèng shì Zhōnghuá yōuxiù chuántǒng wénhuà zhōng 'yǒu péng zì yuǎnfāng lái, bú yì lè hū' de dāngdài chuánchéng. Zài gèdà guójì jīngmào zhǎnhuì yǔ tǐyù shèngshì zhōng, zhìyuànzhěmen yǐ zhēnchéng rèchén de hàokè zhī lǐ yíngjiē sìhǎi bīnpéng, xiàng shìjiè shēngdòng zhǎnxiàn le lǐyí-zhī-bāng de dàguó fēngfàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: 'Hospitable China' reflects the ancient teaching: 'To have friends come from afar, is this not delightful?' In international expos and tournaments, volunteers greet global guests with sincere hospitality, displaying civilizational elegance.
extended_reading_passages.es: 'China hospitalaria' evoca el milenario lema de Confucio: '¿No es un gozo recibir amigos de tierras lejanas?'. En cumbres y torneos internacionales, los voluntarios acogen al forastero con afabilidad, mostrando la hidalguía de una nación de protocolo.

meanings_summary.en: to invite friends; to gather companions together; to call on cronies
meanings_summary.es: convocar a los amigos; reunir a la pandilla; llamar a los compadres

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Shout out (呼) to your peers (朋) and summon (唤) your dear friends (友) to gather merrily (呼朋唤友).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Clama en voz alta (呼) a los compadres (朋) y convoca (唤) a los amigos (友) para festejar juntos (呼朋唤友).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: A classic four-character idiom reflecting traditional Chinese communal sociability; conveys an upbeat, festive atmosphere of spontaneous companionship and merry gatherings.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Level, rising, falling, dipping: 'hū péng huàn yǒu' (55-35-51-214). A rich four-syllable pitch arc moving through all four classic tone contours.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 呼朋唤友 depicts a lively, festive scene of joyously gathering friends and companions for leisure, outings, or dining.

contrasts.compared_word: 呼朋唤友 vs. 结党营私
contrasts.analysis: 呼朋唤友 has a cheerful, wholesome, or neutral lifestyle tone, while 结党营私 is an idiom describing corrupt conspiratorial faction-building.

contrasts.compared_word: 呼朋唤友 vs. 走亲访友
contrasts.analysis: 走亲访友 refers specifically to formal family holiday visits to relatives, while 呼朋唤友 conveys casual, high-spirited peer gatherings.

contrasts.compared_word: 呼朋唤友 vs. 聚众闹事
contrasts.analysis: 聚众闹事 denotes illegal riotous mob behavior, completely antithetical to friendly 呼朋唤友.

senses.definition_en: calling out to summon friends, comrades, and companions to gather, celebrate, or act together
senses.definition_es: llamar o convocar a amigos y compañeros para congregarse, salir de excursión o celebrar juntos
senses.example_phrase: 呼朋唤友去聚餐 (call friends together to have a meal)

example_sentences.hanzi: 春暖花开的时节，大学生们常常呼朋唤友前往郊野公园踏青野餐，享受大自然的美丽风光。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chūnnuǎn-huākāi de shíjié, dàxuéshēngmen chángcháng hūpéng-huànyǒu qiánwǎng jiāoyě gōngyuán tàqīng yěcān, xiǎngshòu dàzìrán de měilì fēngguāng.
example_sentences.en: When spring blossoms bloom, university students often gather friends together to hike in suburban parks, enjoying nature's beauty.
example_sentences.es: Cuando la primavera florece, los universitarios suelen reunir a los amigos para salir de campo al parque campestre y disfrutar del sol.

example_sentences.hanzi: 每逢发了稿费或有朋自远方来，鲁迅先生总爱呼朋唤友前往熟悉的绍兴酒馆，推杯换盏纵论古今。
example_sentences.pinyin: Měiféng fā le gǎofèi huò yǒu péng zì yuǎnfāng lái, Lǔ Xùn xiānsheng zǒng ài hūpéng-huànyǒu qiánwǎng shúxī de Shàoxīng jiǔguǎn, tuībēi-huànzhǎn zònglùn-gǔjīn.
example_sentences.en: Whenever royalties arrived or friends came from afar, Mr. Lu Xun loved gathering companions to local taverns, toasting and debating history.
example_sentences.es: Al cobrar honorarios o recibir visitas de fuera, Lu Xun convocaba a su círculo de amigos hacia las tabernas de Shaoxing para brindar y charlar.
