character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where open mouth 口 exhales sound with vocal force 乎 to call out.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Opening the mouth (口) wide to shout outward into the open air (乎) calls out to distant friends (呼).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Abrir la boca (口) de par en par para soltar la voz al aire (乎) llama a los compadres (呼).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram showing two matched strings of precious cowrie currency, symbolizing equal, bonded friends.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two matching strands of lustrous cowrie shells hang side by side, symbolizing bonded peers and friends (朋).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos hileras gemelas de conchas preciosas penden juntas, simbolizando amigos inseparables (朋).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character combining mouth 口 with 奂, signifying raising the voice to summon or awaken.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Using the mouth (口) to utter a vibrant clear sound (奂) awakens and summons companions (唤).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Con la boca (口) se emite una voz sonora (奂) para despertar y convocar a los cercanos (唤).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram of two right hands 又 reaching out to clasp each other in warm mutual assistance.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two hands reach out in the same direction, clasping together in lifelong loyal friendship (友).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos manos amigas se extienden en el mismo sentido, estrechándose en fraternal lealtad (友).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 金秋十月的周末天高气爽，红叶染透了漫山遍野。平日里忙碌奔波的年轻人纷纷呼朋唤友，背起行囊去登高赏秋。大家坐在山顶的巨石上分享零食畅聊心事，爽朗的笑声穿透松林，在湛蓝的天空下激荡出青春最欢畅的乐章。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jīnqiū shíyuè de zhòumò tiāngāo-qìshuǎng, hóngyè rǎntòu le mànshān-biànyě. Píngrì lǐ mánglù bēnbō de niánqīngrén fēnfēn hūpéng-huànyǒu, bēiqǐ xíngnáng qù dēnggāo shǎngqiū. Dàjiā zuò zài shāndǐng de jùshí shàng fēnxiǎng língshí chàngliáo xīnshì, shuǎnglǎng de xiàoshēng chuāntòu sōnglín, zài zhànlán de tiānkōng xià jīdàng chū qīngchūn zuì huānchàng de yuèzhāng.
extended_reading_passages.en: On an autumn weekend under crisp skies, red leaves blanketed hills. Busy youths gathered companions, packing bags to hike. Sharing snacks on summit boulders and chatting freely, clear laughter echoed through pines, celebrating youth.
extended_reading_passages.es: En un límpido fin de semana de otoño, las hojas tiñen las laderas. Jóvenes atareados convocan a los amigos para coronar la cumbre. Compartiendo viandas sobre las peñas, sus risas francas cruzan los pinares celebrando la juventud.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 文人结社与雅集是近代中国知识界独特的生活方式。无论是在北京胡同里的小酌论道，还是在上海租界的咖啡厅畅谈新思潮，先辈们常常呼朋唤友共同商讨办刊启蒙救国之策。思想的火花在频繁的友人聚会中激烈迸发，推动了时代巨浪。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wénrén jiéshè yǔ yǎjí shì jìndài Zhōngguó zhīshijiè dútè de shēnghuó fāngshì. Wúlùn shì zài Běijīng hútòng lǐ de xiǎozhuó lùndào, háishì zài Shànghǎi zūjiè de kāfēitīng chàngtán xīn sīcháo, xiānbèimen chángcháng hūpéng-huànyǒu gòngtóng shāngtǎo bànkān qǐmēng jiùguó zhī cè. Sīxiǎng de huǒhuā zài pínfán de yǒurén jùhuì zhōng jīliè bèngfā, tuīdòng le shídài jùlàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Literati salons were a hallmark of modern Chinese intellectuals. Whether sipping wine in Beijing hutongs or discussing ideas in Shanghai cafes, predecessors gathered companions to deliberate publications. Sparks from these meetings drove historical tides.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las tertulias letradas marcaron a la intelectualidad moderna. Ya fuera brindando en los callejones de Pekín o debatiendo en cafés de Shanghái, los próceres reunían amigos para fundar revistas y abrir mentes, desatando olas históricas.

meanings_summary.en: to receive guests; to entertain; to treat; reception; hospitality
meanings_summary.es: atender; recibir; agasajar; hospedar; convidar; recepción

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Beckon warmly with your hand (招) and wait attentively by the threshold (待) to entertain guests (招待).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Haz señas acogedoras con la mano (招) y aguarda en el umbral (待) para agasajar a los invitados (招待).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical host-guest ritual (宾主之礼); emphasizes respectful reception, providing seating, tea, and warm culinary comfort.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Level high tone followed by falling tone: 'zhāo dài' (55-51). Articulate 'zhāo' with a steady high pitch 55, then descend firmly on 'dài'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 招待 focuses on hosting, serving food, and providing lodging and hospitality for guests or attendees.

contrasts.analysis: 款待 is more formal and emphasizes deeply generous, lavish, and heartfelt hospitality, while 招待 applies to both grand banquets and basic guesthouse services.
接待 emphasizes the organizational, administrative protocol of receiving delegations at doors, while 招待 emphasizes dining, drinking, and hosting.
招待所 is the physical noun for modest state/institutional guesthouses, while 招待 is the universal verb.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the hand radical 扌 of 招
Has silk radical 纟 on left instead of 扌
Has person radical 亻 on left instead of double-step 彳
Has hand radical 扌 on left instead of 彳

senses.definition_en: to welcome, provide food and lodging for, and look after guests with courtesy
senses.definition_es: recibir, dar de comer, alojar o agasajar a los invitados con atenciones y cortesía
senses.example_phrase: 热情招待来宾 (warmly entertain incoming guests)

example_sentences.hanzi: 逢年过节，祖母总会提前准备好满满一桌丰盛的家乡菜肴，热情招待前来拜年的亲朋好友。
example_sentences.pinyin: Féngnián-guòjié, zǔmǔ zǒng huì tíqián zhǔnbèi hǎo mǎnmǎn yì zhuō fēngshèng de jiāxiāng càiyáo, rèqíng zhāodài qiánlái bàinián de qīnpéng-hǎoyǒu.
example_sentences.en: During holidays, grandmother prepares a full table of lavish hometown dishes to warmly entertain relatives and friends visiting for New Year.
example_sentences.es: En las festividades, la abuela prepara de antemano una opípara mesa de platos tradicionales para agasajar a los allegados que vienen a felicitar.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在近代北京文人圈子中，鲁迅以生性好客著称，广和居的“碎金白菜”是他用来招待知心朋友的招牌菜。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài jìndài Běijīng wénrén quānzi zhōng, Lǔ Xùn yǐ shēngxìng hàokè zhùchēng, Guǎnghéjū de 'suìjīn báicài' shì tā yòng lái zhāodài zhīxīn péngyou de zhāopái cài.
example_sentences.en: In modern Beijing literary circles, Lu Xun was famous for hospitality; Guangheju's signature shredded cabbage was his favorite treat for close friends.
example_sentences.es: En los cenáculos letrados de Pekín, Lu Xun descollaba por su hospitalidad; la col dorada del mesón Guangheju era su plato predilecto para convidar amigos.

idioms.meaning_en: attentive and thoughtful entertainment of guests
guests feel as comfortable as if at home
arrange a banquet to entertain guests lavishly
treat each other with mutual respect like guests

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where hand radical 扌 beckons with gestures to summon 召 someone forward.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A welcoming hand (扌) gestures warmly, calling (召) guests forward to enter the feast (招).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano amable (扌) hace señas con presteza, llamando (召) al visitante hacia el banquete (招).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram showing standing on a path 彳 with courtly decorum 寺, waiting to receive arriving guests.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Standing respectfully along the pathway (彳) near the temple hall (寺), a host waits to attend (待) to guests.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Apostado en la senda (彳) junto al pabellón (寺), el anfitrión aguarda para atender con esmero (待) a los huéspedes.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统的待客之道，最见人间温情。哪怕家中清贫，主人也会倾其所有端出最好的饭菜招待远客。饭桌上频频劝菜的热忱，临别前塞进行囊的土特产，无不浸润着古老农耕文明中最朴素、最真挚的善良与厚道。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng de dàikè zhī dào, zuì jiàn rénjiān wēnqíng. Nǎpà jiāzhōng qīngpín, zhǔrén yě huì qīng qí suǒyǒu duānchū zuì hǎo de fàncài zhāodài yuǎnkè. Fànzhuō shàng pínpín quàncài de rèchén, línbié qián sāijìn xíngnáng de tǔtèchǎn, wúbù jìnrùn zhe gǔlǎo nónggēng wénmíng zhōng zuì pǔsù, zuì zhēnzhì de shànliáng yǔ hòudào.
extended_reading_passages.en: Traditional Chinese hospitality best reveals human warmth. Even in poverty, hosts offer their finest food. Urging extra servings at table and tucking local snacks into departing travelers' bags radiates heartfelt agrarian kindness.
extended_reading_passages.es: La hospitalidad tradicional china destila calidez humana. Aun en la escasez, el dueño de casa ofrece sus mejores manjares. Rogar que repitan plato y regalar viandas para el viaje refleja la entrañable bondad del mundo rural.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在大型国际经贸论坛期间，新闻发布厅与招待会现场秩序井然。组委会不仅精心安排了同声传译与多语种咨询服务，更在晚宴上以融合中西特色的精美冷餐招待中外媒体记者，高效务实的组织工作赢得了与会代表的广泛赞誉。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài dàxíng guójì jīngmào lùntán qījiān, xīnwén fābùtīng yǔ zhāodàihuì xiànchǎng zhìxù-jǐngrán. Zǔwěihuì bùjǐn jīngxīn ānpái le tóngshēng-chuányì yǔ duō yǔzhǒng zīxún fúwù, gèng zài wǎnyàn shàng yǐ rónghé zhōng-xī tèsè de jīngměi lěngcān zhāodài zhōng-wài méitǐ jìzhě, gāoxiào wùshí de zǔzhī gōngzuò yíngdé le yùhuì dàibiǎo de guǎngfàn zànyù.
extended_reading_passages.en: During international economic forums, press halls and receptions run in perfect order. Providing simultaneous translation and hosting journalists with exquisite fusion dinners, the efficient organizing team won broad praise from delegates.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los foros económicos mundiales, las recepciones de prensa discurren con pulcritud. La organización dispuso traducción simultánea y agasajó a los corresponsales con una cena fusión, ganándose el reconocimiento general por su eficacia.

meanings_summary.en: high-grade; top-quality; upscale; high-end; superior
meanings_summary.es: de alta gama; de primera calidad; exclusivo; selecto; de lujo

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Goods placed on the highest (高) wooden shelf tier (档) represent top high-grade quality (高档).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Las mercancías colocadas en el estante de madera (档) más alto (高) pertenecen a la gama superior (高档).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical artisan categorization where goods were sorted on wooden racks (格档) into low, medium, and high tiers (低档, 中档, 高档).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Level high tone followed by falling tone: 'gāo dàng' (55-51). Articulate 'gāo' on level pitch 55, then drop crisply into 4th tone 'dàng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 高档 refers to upscale market classification, superior material quality, and high consumer pricing tier.

contrasts.analysis: 高级 can describe abstract ranks, advanced engineering technology ('高级职称', '高级算法'), while 高档 strictly describes commercial goods, commodities, and venues.
昂贵 solely notes high monetary price, whereas 高档 implies refined materials, exquisite craftsmanship, and prestigious brand status.
低档 (low-end / budget tier) is the direct commercial antonym of 高档.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 冖 and 儿 at bottom instead of 口 in 高
Has 毛 at bottom instead of 口 in 高
Has 木 on left; do not confuse with 挡 (hand radical 扌)
Has metal radical 钅 on left

senses.definition_en: of superior quality, high price, exquisite material, or upscale market grade
senses.definition_es: de calidad superior, precio elevado, acabados esmerados o gama comercial exclusiva
senses.example_phrase: 高档消费品 (high-end consumer goods)

example_sentences.hanzi: 商业步行街两侧林立着各类高档时装旗舰店与珠宝专柜，在璀璨的霓虹灯下显得格外繁华。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shāngyè bùxíngjiē liǎngcè línlì zhe gèlèi gāodàng shízhuāng qíjiàndiàn yǔ zhūbǎo zhuānguì, zài cuǐcàn de níhóngdēng xià xiǎnde géwài fánhuá.
example_sentences.en: Both sides of the pedestrian street are lined with high-end fashion flagships and jewelry counters, looking exceptionally bustling under neon lights.
example_sentences.es: A ambos lados del bulevar peatonal se alinean tiendas de alta costura y joyerías selectas, que lucen vibrantes bajo las luces de neón.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅宴请文友并不盲目迷信昂贵的高档酒楼，而是更看重菜品的独特风味与席间无拘无束的谈兴。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn yànqǐng wényǒu bìng bù mángmù míxìn ángguì de gāodàng jiǔlóu, ér shì gèng kànzhòng càipǐn de dútè fēngwèi yǔ xíjiān wújū-wúshù de tánxìng.
example_sentences.en: When entertaining writer friends, Lu Xun never blindly worshipped costly high-end restaurants, valuing unique flavors and uninhibited conversation far more.
example_sentences.es: Al convidar amigos, Lu Xun no se desvivía por suntuosos mesones de postín, sino que apreciaba el sabor único y la tertulia desenfadada.

idioms.meaning_en: magnificent and stately architectural beauty
value and social stature multiply dramatically
excellent quality at low price (antonym nuance)
a feast for the eyes; dazzling array of precious goods

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 高 (pictogram of a tall multistory tower)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram depicting a tall multistory watchtower with roof, terrace, and entrance archway.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A towering watchtower (高) with lofty roofs and terraces rises above common city rooftops.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una atalaya señorial (高) con terrazas y tejados elevados descuella sobre las casas bajas.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where wooden shelving dividers 木 sort items into designated quality grades 当.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Wooden shelves (木) divide merchandise into proper categories (当), sorting goods into distinct grades (档).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Estantes de madera (木) clasifican los artículos según su valía (当) en distintas gamas (档).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 一个人的品位与格调，从不取决于消费了多少高档奢侈品，而在于对生活细节的专注与审美的纯粹。穿着质朴舒适的布衣，读着启迪智慧的经典，内心的安宁与自信便足以抵御世俗的浮华。真正的贵气，源于精神的丰盈。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yí ge rén de pǐnwèi yǔ gédiào, cóng bù qǔjué yú xiāofèi le duōshǎo gāodàng shēchǐpǐn, ér zàiyú duì shēnghuó xìjié de zhuānzhù yǔ shěnmǐ de chúncuì. Chuānzhe zhìpǔ shūshì de bùyī, dú zhe qǐdí zhìhuì de jīngdiǎn, nèixīn de ānníng yǔ zìxìn biàn zúyǐ dǐyù shìsú de fúhuá. Zhēnzhèng de guìqì, yuányú jīngshén de fēngyíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Taste and stature never depend on consuming high-end luxury, but on mindful attention to detail and pure aesthetics. Wearing simple cotton clothes and reading classics, inner peace and self-assurance easily withstand secular vanity.
extended_reading_passages.es: La distinción no estriba en comprar lujos de alta gama, sino en cuidar los detalles con esmero. Vestir lino sobrio y leer a los clásicos brinda un sosiego y una seguridad que disipan la vanidad terrenal. La nobleza emana del espíritu.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 制造业向高端迈进是经济高质量发展的核心抓手。国内工业母机与高档数控机床研发团队通过突破多轴联动核心算法，全面打破了长期以来的外部技术垄断，不仅提升了高端装备制造国产化率，更为现代化工业体系构筑了坚固防线。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhìzàoyè xiàng gāoduān màijìn shì jīngjì gāo zhìliàng fāzhǎn de héxīn zhuāshǒu. Guónèi gōngyè mǔjī yǔ gāodàng shùkòng jīchuáng yánfā tuánduì tōngguò tūpò duōzhóu liándòng héxīn suànfǎ, quánmiàn dǎpò le chángqī yǐlái de wàibù jìshù lǒngduàn, bùjǐn tíshēng le gāoduān zhuāngbèi zhìzào guóchǎnhuà lǜ, gèng wèi xiàndàihuà gōngyè tǐxì gòuzhù le jiāngù fángxiàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Stepping into high-end manufacturing drives economic quality. Breaching monopolies in high-grade CNC machine tools and core algorithms, domestic teams raised domestic equipment ratios, fortifying defenses for modern industry.
extended_reading_passages.es: El avance hacia la alta gama fabril dinamiza la economía. Los equipos de mecanizado avanzado rompieron monopolios técnicos al desarrollar algoritmos propios, elevando la cuota de producción nacional y blindando la industria moderna.

meanings_summary.en: appetite; liking; taste; interest; ambition
meanings_summary.es: apetito; ganas de comer; gusto; inclinación; ambición

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When the stomach (胃) desires food, the mouth (口) salivates with eager appetite (胃口).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando el estómago (胃) pide sustento, la boca (口) se abre con vivo apetito (胃口).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Metaphorical mapping between physical digestion and cognitive taste; Chinese treats intellectual interest ('duì wèikǒu', 对胃口) and ambitious desire ('wèikǒu dà', 胃口大) as bodily appetite.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling tone followed by dipping tone: 'wèi kǒu' (51-214). Pronounce 'wèi' firmly, followed by an undulating 3rd tone on 'kǒu'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 胃口 denotes physical hunger/desire to eat, or metaphorically represents taste, interest, or ambition.

contrasts.analysis: 食欲 is a formal, medical/physiological term strictly referring to biological desire for food, while 胃口 is widely used idiomatically for taste ('吊胃口').
兴趣 denotes general intellectual hobby or curious interest, while 胃口 when used metaphorically carries a zestful, hungry pursuit of a match.
胃病 is clinical pathology (gastric disease), while 胃口 describes functional desire for food.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Top structure has roof framing, unlike 田 in 胃
Has 小 at top instead of 田
Has horizontal bar in center, unlike open square 口
Has vertical stroke piercing through center of 口

senses.definition_en: physiological desire for food; physical appetite
senses.definition_es: deseo fisiológico de ingerir alimentos; apetito corporal
senses.example_phrase: 胃口很好 (have a very good appetite)

senses.definition_en: interest, taste, or appetite for specific arts, activities, or business ventures
senses.definition_es: inclinación, afición, gusto o ambición por determinados temas o proyectos
senses.example_phrase: 不对胃口 (not to one's liking/taste)

example_sentences.hanzi: 这道酸辣爽口的开胃小菜色泽诱人，让人一尝之下顿时胃口大开，连吃了两碗白米饭。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào suānlà shuǎngkǒu de kāiwèi xiǎocài sèzé yòurén, ràng rén yì cháng zhīxià dùnshí wèikǒu dà kāi, lián chī le liǎng wǎn bái mǐfàn.
example_sentences.en: This sour and spicy appetizer is enticing; tasting it immediately stimulated my appetite, so I ate two bowls of rice in a row.
example_sentences.es: Este aperitivo agridulce y crujiente abre el apetito con su color seductor; tras catarlo comí dos cuencos de arroz seguidos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅晚年虽然胃病时常发作，但每逢故乡好友带来绍兴梅干菜与糟肉，他依然胃口极佳地品尝几筷。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn wǎnnián suīrán wèibìng shícháng fāzuò, dàn měiféng gùxiāng hǎoyǒu dàilái Shàoxīng méigāncài yǔ zāoròu, tā yīrán wèikǒu jí jiā de pǐncháng jǐ kuài.
example_sentences.en: Although suffering frequent stomach trouble in later years, whenever hometown friends brought Shaoxing dried mustard greens and wine pork, he tasted them with great appetite.
example_sentences.es: Pese a padecer achaques de estómago en sus últimos años, cuando paisanos le traían carne curada de Shaoxing comía con gran apetito.

collocations.en: keep someone on tenterhooks; whet appetite

idioms.meaning_en: with great relish; thoroughly enjoyable
wolf down food like wolves and tigers; ravenous
food lacks sweet flavor; too worried to eat with relish
abyss of desire is hard to fill; insatiable appetite

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone pictogram of the stomach sac storing grain 田 above the flesh radical 月/肉.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A fleshy digestive sac (月) holding grains of food (田) represents the vital stomach organ (胃).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una bolsa carnosa (月) que almacena los granos ingeridos (田) representa el estómago (胃).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram depicting an open human mouth receiving sustenance.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An open mouth (口) cheerfully receives delicious food to nourish the body.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una boca abierta (口) acoge gozosa los bocados para nutrir el organismo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 心情舒畅的时候，粗茶淡饭也能吃得津津有味；心事重重之际，即便面对山珍海味也难有丝毫胃口。人生的胃口往往是内心境遇的晴雨表。学会卸下过重的精神包袱，放慢脚步体会当下的清欢，生活的滋味自然会甘之如饴。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xīnqíng shūchàng de shíhòu, chūchá-dànfàn yě néng chī de jīnjīn-yǒuwèi; xīnshì-chóngchóng zhī jì, jíbiàn miànduì shānzhēn-hǎiwèi yě nán yǒu sīháo wèikǒu. Rénshēng de wèikǒu wǎngwǎng shì nèixīn jìngyù de qíngyǔbiǎo. Xuéhuì xièxià guòzhòng de jīngshén bāofu, fàngmàn jiǎobù tǐhuì dāngxià de qīnghuān, shēnghuó de zīwèi zìrán huì gānzhī-rúyí.
extended_reading_passages.en: When lighthearted, simple fare is savored; weighed down by worry, delicacies spark no appetite. Appetite mirrors the soul. Learning to unload burdens and slow down lets life's flavors become sweet again naturally.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con el ánimo alegre, la comida humilde sabe a gloria; abrumado de pesares, los manjares no despiertan apetito. Las ganas de comer son barómetro del alma. Aliviar fardos y desacelerar permite saborear de nuevo la dulzura de vivir.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在影视内容创作领域，盲目迎合市场的速食产品正在逐渐败坏受众的观影胃口。同质化严重的悬疑套路与低俗搞笑，引发了观众强烈的审美疲劳。唯有扎根现实生活、用心打磨剧本思想深度的原创精品，才能真正满足大众日益提升的文化胃口。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài yǐngshì nèiróng chuàngzuò lǐngyù, mángmù yínghé shìchǎng de sùshí chǎnpǐn zhèngzài zhújiàn bàihuài shòuzhòng de guānyǐng wèikǒu. Tóngzhìhuà yánzhòng de xuányí tàolù yǔ dīsú gǎoxiào, yǐnfā le guānzhòng qiángliè de shěnmǐ pílào. Wéiyǒu zhāgēn xiànshí shēnghuó, yòngxīn dǎmó jùběn sīxiǎng shēndù de yuánchuàng jīngpǐn, cáinéng zhēnzhèng mǎnzú dàzhòng rìyì tíshēng de wénhuà wèikǒu.
extended_reading_passages.en: In film and television, formulaic fast-food content spoils audience appetite. Clichéd plots cause aesthetic fatigue. Only genuine originals rooted in life with deep scripts can satisfy the public's rising cultural appetite.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la creación audiovisual, los productos clónicos arruinan el paladar del espectador. El exceso de fórmulas manidas genera hastío. Solo guiones meditados con hondura humana satisfacen las exigencias de un público cada vez más formado.

meanings_summary.en: obviously; plainly; undoubtedly; clearly; manifestly (often introducing a contrast)
meanings_summary.es: a todas luces; patentemente; a ojos vistas; evidentemente; cuando es bien sabido que

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Reduplicating bright light (明) upon bright clarity (明) makes an undeniable truth obvious and manifest (明明).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Duplicar la luz clara (明) sobre la claridad evidente (明) hace que la verdad salte a la vista (明明).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Reduplication of 'míng' intensifies subjective certitude; used in rhetorical discourse when pointing out a glaring contrast between known reality and someone's evasive behavior.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two rising tones: 'míng míng' (35-35). Two steady parallel upward sweeps from mid pitch to high.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 明明 is an adverb emphasizing an undeniable fact, almost always set against an unjustified denial or contradictory action.

contrasts.analysis: 明显 is an adjective meaning obvious or discernible ('明显的变化'), while 明明 is an adverb modifying verbs with contrastive emphasis ('他明明知道').
显然 means evidently or obviously deduced from clues ('显然他是对的'), while 明明 carries an emotional tone of indignation at contradiction.
明确 is an adjective/verb meaning explicit, unambiguous, or to clarify ('明确目标'), not an emphatic adverb.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has two moons 月 月 side-by-side instead of 日 and 月
Has 召 on right instead of 月
Has 王 on right of 日 instead of 月
Has 音 on right; direct antonym of 明

senses.definition_en: plainly, visibly, or undeniably true; often used before a clause that highlights an unexpected contradiction or denial
senses.definition_es: manifiestamente, a todas luces o a ojos vistas; suele contraponer una evidencia a una negación injustificada
senses.example_phrase: 明明知道却不说 (obviously know but refuse to say)

example_sentences.hanzi: 天气预报明明说了今天全天有大暴雨，他出门时却偏偏不带伞，结果被淋成了落汤鸡。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào míngmíng shuō le jīntiān quántiān yǒu dà bàoyǔ, tā chūmén shí què piānpiān bú dài sǎn, jiéguǒ bèi línchéng le luòtāngjī.
example_sentences.en: The weather forecast plainly stated heavy rain all day, yet he stubbornly brought no umbrella and got soaked to the bone.
example_sentences.es: El parte meteorológico anunció claramente aguaceros para todo el día; él salió sin paraguas y acabó empapado como una sopa.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅明明患有严重的胃病需要静养忌口，但面对好友热忱的邀约，他依然欣然前往，舍命陪君子。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn míngmíng huànyǒu yánzhòng de wèibìng xūyào jìngyǎng jìkǒu, dàn miànduì hǎoyǒu rèchén de yāoyuē, tā yīrán xīnrán qiánwǎng, shěmìng péi jūnzǐ.
example_sentences.en: Lu Xun clearly suffered severe gastric troubles requiring diet restrictions, yet facing friends' warm invitations, he still joined happily.
example_sentences.es: Lu Xun padecía patentemente de males estomacales y debía guardar dieta; aun así, ante la invitación de amigos acudía solícito a departir.

collocations.en: plainly saw with one's own eyes

idioms.meaning_en: see down to the finest autumn down hair; clear discernment
black and white are clearly demarcated; unmistakable
as clear as looking at a bright blazing fire
abundantly manifest; exposed in broad daylight

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram pairing the solar disc 日 with the lunar crescent 月 (or window 囧), symbolizing radiant clarity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The brilliant sun (日) and glowing moon (月) shine together, illuminating all things with undeniable clarity (明).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El sol radiante (日) y la luna llena (月) brillan juntos, alumbrando la verdad sin sombra de duda (明).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 生活中最令人叹息的隔阂，莫过于彼此明明深爱着对方，却在赌气与沉默中渐行渐远。很多误会明明只需要一句坦诚的解释便能烟消云散，却偏偏被虚荣的面子硬生生演变成了经年遗憾。学会低头，才是成熟的开端。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shēnghuó zhōng zuì lìngrén tànxī de géhé, mòguòyú bǐcǐ míngmíng shēn'ài zhe duìfāng, què zài dǔqì yǔ chénmò zhōng jiànxíng-jiànyuǎn. Hěnduō wùhuì míngmíng zhǐ xūyào yí jù tǎnchéng de jiěshì biàn néng yānxiāo-yúnsàn, què piānpiān bèi xūróng de miànzi yìngshēngshēng yǎnbiàn chéng le jīngnián yíhàn. Xuéhuì dītóu, cáishì chéngshú de kāiduān.
extended_reading_passages.en: Life's saddest distance is when two people clearly love each other yet drift apart in silence. Many misunderstandings plainly need only one sincere word to dissolve, yet pride turns them into regrets. Yielding is the start of maturity.
extended_reading_passages.es: La mayor desazón surge cuando dos personas se quieren con evidencia, pero se distancian por orgullo. Muchos malentendidos se disiparían con una frase franca, mas la vanidad los torna pesares. Aprender a ceder es el principio de la madurez.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 科研求真最忌讳掩耳盗铃。实验数据明明已经出现了无法自圆其说的反常偏差，个别学者却为了迎合既定课题结论，试图对异常数值进行修饰遮掩。科学的大厦唯有建立在实事求是的铁证之上，任何侥幸弄虚作假终将被历史证伪。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Kēyán qiúzhēn zuì jìhuì yǎn'ěr-dàolíng. Shíyàn shùjù míngmíng yǐjīng chūxiàn le wúfǎ zìyuán-qíshuō de fǎncháng piānchā, gèbié xuézhě què wèile yínghé jìdìng kètí jiélùn, shìtú duì yìcháng shùzhí jìnxíng xiūshì zhēyǎn. Kēxué de dàshà wéiyǒu jiànlì zài shíshì-qiúshì de tiězhèng zhīshàng, rènhé jiǎoxìng nòngxū-zuòjiǎ zhōng jiāng bèi lìshǐ zhèngwěi.
extended_reading_passages.en: Scientific rigor abhors self-deception. Experimental data plainly shows anomalous discrepancies, yet some attempt to gloss over them to fit conclusions. Science must stand on ironclad evidence; falsification will inevitably be disproven by history.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la ciencia está proscrito engañarse. Aunque los datos muestren a todas luces desvíos anómalos, maquillar cifras para encajar hipótesis falsea el rigor. El templo del saber se asienta sobre pruebas de hierro; la trampa sucumbe ante la verdad.

meanings_summary.en: stomach; gastric organ; belly
meanings_summary.es: estómago; órgano digestivo gástrico

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The flesh pouch (月) that holds and digests field grains (田) is your vital stomach (胃).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La bolsa carnosa (月) que digiere los granos del campo (田) es el estómago (胃).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) refers to the stomach as the 'Sea of Grain and Water' (水谷之海) and the minister of granaries (仓廪之官), vital for postnatal vitality.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone: 'wèi' (51). Crisp, solid descending contour from pitch 5 to pitch 1.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 胃 strictly denotes the anatomical stomach organ responsible for breaking down food.

contrasts.analysis: 肚子 is the broad colloquial word for the entire external belly or abdominal cavity, while 胃 is the specific internal organ.
胃 is the physical organ, whereas 胃口 is appetite or psychological interest in something.
肠胃 is a collective term for the entire gastrointestinal tract (stomach and intestines), while 胃 is solely the stomach.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 冎 at top instead of 田 in 胃
Has roof 宀 at top instead of 田
Has water radical 氵 on the left of 胃
Has speech radical 讠 on the left of 胃

senses.definition_en: the muscular organ of the digestive tract in humans and animals where food is broken down
senses.definition_es: órgano muscular del aparato digestivo de humanos y animales donde se descomponen los alimentos
senses.example_phrase: 保护胃部健康 (protect stomach health)

example_sentences.hanzi: 经常不规律进食和暴饮暴食极易损伤脆弱的胃黏膜，导致慢性胃炎等消化系统疾病发作。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngcháng bù guīlǜ jìnshí hé bàoyǐn-bàoshí jí yì sǔnshāng cuìruò de wèi niánmó, dǎozhì mànxìng wèiyán děng xiāohuà xìtǒng jíbìng fāzuò.
example_sentences.en: Irregular eating and bingeing easily damage the delicate stomach mucosa, triggering chronic gastritis and digestive ailments.
example_sentences.es: Comer a deshoras y darse atracones daña la mucosa gástrica, provocando gastritis crónica y desórdenes digestivos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 根据鲁迅先生的日记与书信考证，他在北京和上海写作期间常年饱受胃病折磨，严重时夜不能寐。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gēnjù Lǔ Xùn xiānsheng de rìjì yǔ shūxìn kǎozhèng, tā zài Běijīng hé Shànghǎi xiězuò qījiān chángnián bǎoshòu wèibìng zhémó, yánzhòng shí yè bùnéng mèi.
example_sentences.en: Researching Lu Xun's diaries confirms he suffered year-round from stomach illness while writing, frequently kept awake at night.
example_sentences.es: Los diarios de Lu Xun atestiguan que padeció intensas dolencias de estómago mientras escribía, perdiendo el sueño en sus crisis.

idioms.meaning_en: rub one's eyes and look at someone with new respect
reflect deeply on painful lessons after pain subsides
the way of preserving health and life
drink poison to quench thirst; seek relief with disastrous means

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone pictogram of a fleshy muscular pouch 月 storing grain harvests 田 for digestion.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A muscular organ pouch of flesh (月) receives grains from the rice fields (田) to digest in the stomach (胃).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una bolsa carnosa (月) asimila los granos del campo (田) para hacer la digestión gástrica (胃).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 胃是人体中最敏感的情绪器官之一。长期的焦虑、紧张与熬夜，往往会通过神经系统迅速波及胃部，引起痉挛与隐痛。呵护好自己的胃，按时吃一顿温热的三餐，不仅是保持身体健康的底线，更是对疲惫心灵最温存的体恤。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wèi shì réntǐ zhōng zuì mǐngǎn de qíngxù qìguān zhīyī. Chángqī de jiāolǜ, jǐnzhāng yǔ áoyè, wǎngwǎng huì tōngguò shénjīng xìtǒng xùnsù bōjí wèibù, yǐnqǐ jìngluán yǔ yǐntòng. Hēhù hǎo zìjǐ de wèi, ànshí chī yí dùn wēnrè de sāncān, bùjǐn shì bǎochí shēntǐ jiànkāng de dǐxiàn, gèng shì duì píbèi xīnlíng zuì wēncún de tǐxù.
extended_reading_passages.en: The stomach is one of the body's most sensitive emotional organs. Anxiety and sleep deprivation swiftly strike through the nervous system, causing cramps and aches. Caring for one's stomach with warm, regular meals is gentlest comfort.
extended_reading_passages.es: El estómago es uno de los órganos más sensibles a las emociones. La ansiedad constante y el desvelo alteran los nervios, provocando cólicos. Cuidar la digestión y comer caliente a sus horas es el mayor mimo para un cuerpo fatigado.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随着幽门螺旋杆菌筛查技术的广泛普及，我国早期胃癌的诊疗水平取得了长足进步。消化内科专家呼吁，四十岁以上高危人群应当定期接受无痛胃镜检查，做到早发现、早诊断、早干预，筑牢消化道肿瘤防控的坚固屏障。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suízhe yōumén luóxuángǎnjūn shāichá jìshù de guǎngfàn pǔjí, wǒguó zǎoqī wèiyán de zhěnliáo shuǐpǐng qǔdé le chángzú jìnbù. Xiāohuà nèikē zhuānjiā hūyù, sìshí suì yǐshàng gāowēi rénqún yīngdāng dìngqī jiēshòu wútòng wèijìng jiǎnchá, zuòdào zǎo fāxiàn, zǎo zhěnduàn, zǎo gānyù, zhùláo xiāohuàdào zhǒngliú fángkòng de jiāngù píngzhàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: With widespread screening for H. pylori, early gastric cancer diagnosis has progressed significantly. Gastroenterologists urge those over 40 to undergo painless gastroscopy regularly for early detection and intervention.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con el cribado de Helicobacter pylori, la detección precoz del cáncer gástrico ha avanzado a pasos agigantados. Los especialistas recomiendan gastroscopias preventivas a mayores de 40 años para atajar a tiempo cualquier anomalía.

meanings_summary.en: to give up; to quit; to abstain from; to warn; to guard against
meanings_summary.es: dejar de; abandonar (un hábito); abstenerse; prevenir; precaverse

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Hold weapons high in defensive guard (戒) to cut off and quit destructive addictions (戒).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Empuña el arma en guardia vigilante (戒) para erradicar y dejar hábitos perniciosos (戒).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Originating from military garrison sentries holding halberds; adopted in Buddhist monastic rules (戒律, śīla) as moral prohibitions against vices, and later in medicine for cessation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone: 'jiè' (51). Crisp, decisive descent from pitch 5 to pitch 1, reflecting resolute willpower.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 戒 denotes proactively and resolutely severing an ingrained addiction or habit through conscious willpower.

contrasts.analysis: 戒备 is solely a noun or verb meaning defensive military/security alert against external enemies, while 戒 alone often means quitting habits ('戒烟').
放弃 means giving up rights, opportunities, or struggles passively, whereas 戒 means voluntarily quitting harmful addictions.
禁 means external prohibition by law or authority ('禁止吸烟'), while 戒 emphasizes personal internal self-restraint ('戒烟').

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 十 cross inside 戈 instead of two parallel vertical lines of 戒
Has 勹 wrapped inside 戈
Has 口 and 一 inside 戈
Has tree radical 木 on left side of 戒

senses.definition_en: to renounce, quit, or abstain from an addictive habit such as smoking or drinking
senses.definition_es: abandonar, dejar o abstenerse de un mal hábito adictivo como fumar o beber
senses.example_phrase: 戒烟戒酒 (quit smoking and drinking)

senses.definition_en: to guard against, take warning from, or be vigilant against errors or vices
senses.definition_es: precaverse, precaver o guardarse de cometer faltas o vicios
senses.example_phrase: 引以为戒 (take as a warning)

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了改善日益严重的慢性咽喉炎与心肺健康，父亲下定决心彻底戒掉了抽了三十年的香烟。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile gǎishàn rìyì yánzhòng de mànxìng yānhóuyán yǔ xīnfèi jiànkāng, fùqīn xiàdìng juéxīn chèdǐ jièdiào le chōu le sānshí nián de xiāngyān.
example_sentences.en: To improve worsening chronic pharyngitis and cardiopulmonary health, father firmly resolved to completely quit smoking cigarettes after thirty years.
example_sentences.es: Para aliviar su faringitis crónica y proteger el corazón, el padre decidió con firmeza dejar para siempre el tabaco tras treinta años fumando.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅晚年因肺病与胃病屡屡发作，医生曾严厉告诫他必须戒酒戒烟，但他为了写作依然难以割舍烟草。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn wǎnnián yīn fèibìng yǔ wèibìng lǚlǚ fāzuò, yīshēng céng yánlì gàojiè tā bìxū jièjiǔ jièyān, dàn tā wèile xiězuò yīrán nányǐ gēshě yāncǎo.
example_sentences.en: Suffering recurrent lung and stomach crises in his final years, doctors sternly warned Lu Xun to quit alcohol and tobacco, but writing kept him bound to it.
example_sentences.es: Por sus afecciones de pulmón y estómago, los médicos conminaron a Lu Xun a dejar el tabaco y el alcohol; mas para escribir no podía prescindir de fumar.

idioms.meaning_en: guard against arrogance and impetuosity
warning from the overturned cart ahead; lessons from past errors
mount strict security vigilance
criticize former errors to take warning for the future

character_decomposition.meaning_en: warn; guard against; quit; ring; precept
character_decomposition.meaning_component: 戈 (dagger-axe weapon) + 廾 (two hands holding weapon)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram showing two hands 廾 firmly gripping a halberd 戈 in defensive guard against danger.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two hands hold a halberd (戈) ready on guard to warn against incoming danger and ward off bad habits (戒).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos manos empuñan la alabarda (戈) en guardia defensiva, alertando del peligro y cortando malos hábitos (戒).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 戒除一个根深蒂固的不良嗜好，本质上是一场与自我惰性的顽强博弈。无论是放下对尼古丁的依赖，还是告别深夜沉迷手机的恶习，都需要刮骨疗毒的决绝勇气。唯有敢于向昨天的软弱告别，生命才能重获清爽与掌控。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jièchú yí ge gēnshēn-dìgù de bùliáng shìhào, běnzhì shàng shì yì chǎng yǔ zìwǒ duòxìng de wánqiáng bóyì. Wúlùn shì fàngxià duì nígǔdīng de yīlài, háishì gàobié shēnyè chénmí shǒujī de èxí, dōu xūyào guāgǔ-liáodú de juéjué yǒngqì. Wéiyǒu gǎnyú xiàng zuótiān de ruǎnruò gàobié, shēngmìng cáinéng chónghuò qīngshuǎng yǔ zhǎngkòng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Quitting an ingrained vice is essentially a tenacious duel with personal inertia. Whether abandoning nicotine or midnight screen addiction, it takes resolute courage. Only by daring to part with past weakness can life regain fresh mastery.
extended_reading_passages.es: Erradicar un vicio arraigado es un pulso tenaz contra la inercia interior. Romper con la nicotina o el desvelo ante las pantallas exige coraje sin titubeos. Solo despidiéndose de la flaqueza pretérita recobra la vida su vigor y timón.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 面对瞬息万变的金融衍生品市场，投资机构必须时刻紧绷风险防控之弦，切忌盲目激进加杠杆。行业监管部门发布的一系列风险预警通报，督促各类资产管理机构引以为戒，切实完善内控合规体系，坚决守住不发生系统性金融风险的底线。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Miànduì shùnxī-wànbiàn de jīnróng yǎnshēngpǐn shìchǎng, tóuzī jīgòu bìxū shíkè jǐnběng fēngxiǎn fángkòng zhī xián, qièjì mángmù jījìn jiā gànggǎn. Hángyè jiānguǎn bùmén fābù de yíxìliè fēngxiǎn yùjǐng tōngbào, dūcù gèlèi zīchǎn guǎnlǐ jīgòu yǐnyǐwéijiè, qièshí wánshàn nèikòng hégūi tǐxì, jiānjué shǒuzhù bù fāshēng xìtǒngxìng jīnróng fēngxiǎn de dǐxiàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In volatile financial markets, investment institutions must keep risk control tight, strictly avoiding blind leverage. Regulatory warnings urge firms to take heed, refine compliance, and firmly defend the baseline against systemic risks.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante mercados financieros volátiles, los fondos deben extremar el control de riesgos y evitar el apalancamiento temerario. Las advertencias de los supervisores instan a precaverse y afianzar la auditoría, blindando la estabilidad sistémica.

meanings_summary.en: to preserve; to conserve; to keep; to save (files/data); to maintain intact
meanings_summary.es: guardar; conservar; preservar; mantener; salvar (archivos informáticos)

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Protect with loving care (保) so that precious heritage continues to exist intact (存), preserving it safely (保存).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Ampara con celo (保) para que el legado siga existiendo intacto (存), logrando conservarlo (保存).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Combining protective guardianship (保) with existential permanence (存); in traditional culture, preserving family ancestral tablets (宗祠) and genealogies formed the sacred core of continuity.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping tone followed by rising tone: 'bǎo cún' (214-35). Syllable 'bǎo' dips down, followed by an energetic rising tone on 'cún'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 保存 focuses on keeping physical items, documents, food, or computer files intact without loss or spoilage.

contrasts.analysis: 保留 emphasizes keeping or retaining rights, opinions, seats, or customs without altering them, while 保存 emphasizes protecting items from physical/digital decay.
保护 focuses on shielding an entity from active external danger, violence, or harm, whereas 保存 focuses on storage and long-term conservation.
存储 is a technical computing/warehousing term for storing large volumes of data or physical stock, while 保存 is general and everyday.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has earth radical 土 at bottom of 保
Has 土 at bottom instead of 子 in 存
Has 口 at bottom instead of 子
Has 又 at bottom instead of 子

senses.definition_en: to keep things, documents, or biological specimens safe, undamaged, and intact over time
senses.definition_es: guardar cosas, documentos o muestras para que no se deterioren, pierdan o dañen
senses.example_phrase: 妥善保存文件 (keep documents safe and well-preserved)

senses.definition_en: to save electronic computer files, database records, or digital configurations
senses.definition_es: guardar o salvar archivos informáticos, bases de datos o configuraciones en soporte digital
senses.example_phrase: 保存修改内容 (save modified contents)

example_sentences.hanzi: 这些泛黄的老照片被外婆妥善保存在铁盒子里，记录了半个世纪以来全家人的温情岁月。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē fànhuáng de lǎo zhàopiàn bèi wàipó tuǒshàn bǎocún zài tiě hézi lǐ, jìlù le bàn ge shìjì yǐlái quánjiā rén de wēnqíng suìyuè.
example_sentences.en: These yellowed old photos were properly preserved by grandmother in a tin box, documenting half a century of family warmth.
example_sentences.es: Estas fotos amarillentas fueron conservadas por la abuela en una lata, guardando medio siglo de entrañable memoria familiar.

example_sentences.hanzi: 北京鲁迅博物馆精心保存了鲁迅生前的大量珍贵手稿、藏书和生活用具，具有极高的历史文化价值。
example_sentences.pinyin: Běijīng Lǔ Xùn Bówùguǎn jīngxīn bǎocún le Lǔ Xùn shēngqián de dàliàng zhēnguì shǒugǎo, cángshū hé shēnghuó yòngjù, jùyǒu jí gāo de lìshǐ wénhuà jiàzhí.
example_sentences.en: The Beijing Lu Xun Museum meticulously preserves many of his manuscripts, book collections, and daily utensils, of immense cultural value.
example_sentences.es: El Museo Lu Xun de Pekín conserva con celo manuscritos, volúmenes y enseres de su vida cotidiana, de incalculable valor histórico.

idioms.meaning_en: remain fresh and vibrant with the passage of time
return the jade intact to Zhao; return untouched to owner
safe and sound without the slightest blemish
the sole surviving great fruit; one of the few survivors

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram showing an adult guardian 亻 carrying an infant child on their back, protecting it from harm.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A loving adult (亻) holds a baby safely swaddled on their back, protecting and keeping it unharmed (保).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un tutor protector (亻) lleva a un niño a la espalda, amparándolo y protegiéndolo de todo daño (保).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram showing a fresh sprout 才 sprouting above an offspring 子, signifying ongoing existence and survival.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A tender sprout grows safely under roof shelter for the child (子), ensuring it survives and exists (存).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un brote tierno germina al amparo del hogar para el niño (子), garantizando su subsistencia (存).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 岁月是一条奔流不息的大河，唯有那些被爱妥善保存的记忆，才能在时光的淘洗中闪耀出温润的光泽。一封泛黄的家书，一枚斑驳的纪念章，静静躺在抽屉深处，默默守护着漫漫人生旅途中最珍贵的深情与执着。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suìyuè shì yì tiáo bēnliú-bùxī de dàhé, wéiyǒu nàxiē bèi ài tuǒshàn bǎocún de jìyì, cáinéng zài shíguāng de táoxǐ zhōng shǎnyào chū wēnrùn de guāngzé. Yì fēng fànhuáng de jiāshū, yì méi bānbó de jìniànzhāng, jìngjìng tǎng zài chōutì shēnchù, mòmò shǒuhù zhe mànmàn rénshēng lǚtú zhōng zuì zhēnguì de shēnqíng yǔ zhízhuó.
extended_reading_passages.en: Years are a rushing river; only memories lovingly preserved shine with warm luster through time. A yellowed family letter and a worn medal lying in a drawer quietly guard life's most precious devotion and resolve.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los años son un río impetuoso; solo los recuerdos conservados con amor brillan en el tiempo. Una carta amarillenta y una medalla gastada en el cajón custodian en silencio los afectos más puros y nobles del camino vivido.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 古籍文献数字化工程为抢救与永久保存珍贵古籍开辟了全新路径。技术团队采用高光谱无损扫描与三维建模技术，将宋元珍本的纸张纤维与朱墨字迹完好记录。这不仅实现了历史典籍的永久保存，更极大地促进了中华优秀传统文化的开放共享。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Gǔjí wénxiàn shùzìhuà gōngchéng wèi qiǎngjiù yǔ yǒngjiǔ bǎocún zhēnguì gǔjí kāipì le quánxīn lùjìng. Jìshù tuánduì cǎiyòng gāoguāngpǔ wúsǔn sǎomiáo yǔ sānwéi jiànmó jìshù, jiāng Sòng-Yuán zhēnběn de zhǐzhāng xiānwéi yǔ zhūmò zìjì wánhǎo jìlù. Zhè bùjǐn shíxiàn le lìshǐ diǎnjí de yǒngjiǔ bǎocún, gèng jídà de cùjìn le Zhōnghuá yōuxiù chuántǒng wénhuà de kāifàng gòngxiǎng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Digitization of ancient manuscripts opens new paths for permanent preservation. Using non-destructive scanning and 3D modeling, teams record Song and Yuan rarities, ensuring eternal conservation and promoting open cultural sharing.
extended_reading_passages.es: La digitalización abre nuevas vías para conservar incunables antiguos. Mediante escaneo hiperespectral no invasivo y modelado 3D, se capturan las fibras de códices Song y Yuan, garantizando su preservación y divulgación pública.

meanings_summary.en: data; material; information; reference documents; resources
meanings_summary.es: datos; material; información; documentación; fuentes de referencia

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Gather your informational capital resources (资) and measure raw facts like grain (料) to compile research data (资料).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Reúne tus recursos de información (资) y mide los datos como grano (料) para compilar documentación (资料).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Combining economic funds (资) with measured physical ingredients (料); expanded in modern lexicography to encompass intellectual resources and data.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Level high tone followed by falling tone: 'zī liào' (55-51). Articulate 'zī' on level pitch 55, then descend firmly on 'liào'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 资料 emphasizes factual, textual, or statistical reference inputs collected for research, writing, or practical production.

contrasts.analysis: 材料 emphasizes physical substances used in manufacture (steel, wood) or written drafts, while 资料 emphasizes intellectual data and reference documents.
信息 refers to dynamic real-time communication signals, messages, or news data, while 资料 denotes compiled reference documents and dossiers.
数据 strictly refers to quantitative numerical figures, metrics, and computer bits, while 资料 includes qualitative texts and images.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has woman radical 女 at bottom instead of 贝
Has 禾 on left instead of 米 in 料
Has hand radical 扌 on left instead of 米
Has 余 on left instead of 米

senses.definition_en: factual information, archival documents, statistics, or reference sources collected for study or work
senses.definition_es: información factual, documentos de archivo, estadísticas o fuentes de consulta reunidas para el trabajo
senses.example_phrase: 搜集第一手资料 (collect firsthand material)

senses.definition_en: material means or resources for production or living
senses.definition_es: medios de producción o subsistencia material para la vida
senses.example_phrase: 生产资料与生活资料 (means of production and means of subsistence)

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了撰写毕业论文，他在图书馆查阅了大量的历史档案资料，做了厚厚三大本读书笔记。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile zhuànxiě bìyè lùnwén, tā zài túshūguǎn cháyuè le dàliàng de lìshǐ dàng'àn zīliào, zuò le hòuhòu sān dà běn dúshū bǐjì.
example_sentences.en: To write his thesis, he consulted a large volume of historical archival material in the library, filling three thick notebooks.
example_sentences.es: Para redactar su tesis, consultó copiosa documentación de archivo en la biblioteca, llenando tres gruesos cuadernos de notas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 学者们通过比对鲁迅日记与民国报刊资料，系统还原了他当年在京沪两地的交往脉络与餐饮开销。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xuézhěmen tōngguò bǐduì Lǔ Xùn rìjì yǔ Mínguó bàokān zīliào, xìtǒng huányuán le tā dāngnián zài Jīng-Hù liǎng dì de jiāowǎng màiluò yǔ cānyǐn kāixiāo.
example_sentences.en: By comparing Lu Xun's diaries with Republican newspaper records, scholars systematically reconstructed his social network and dining expenses.
example_sentences.es: Cotejando los diarios de Lu Xun con la hemeroteca republicana, los expertos reconstruyeron su red de amistades y sus cuentas gastronómicas.

idioms.meaning_en: quote classic texts and cite authoritative sources
collect and comb through almost everything thoroughly
proven true by verifiable evidence and reliable documentation
immense volume of books making pack-oxen sweat; voluminous

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Neatly stacked cowrie coins (贝) supply the vital financial capital and resources (资) for projects.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Monedas de concha (贝) apiladas con orden brindan el capital y los fondos necesarios (资).

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Using a wooden measuring ladle (斗) to scoop out grain rations (米) provides raw materials (料).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Con el cazo de medir (斗) se reparte la ración de grano (米), suministrando la materia prima (料).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 学术研究是一场板凳甘坐十年冷的漫长探索。学者为了弄清一个历史细节，往往需要在浩瀚如烟海的古籍资料中反复搜求、比对考证。正是在这一份份泛黄的档案资料里，历史那模糊的面庞才一点点变得清晰可感。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xuéshù yánjiū shì yì chǎng bǎndèng gānzuò shí nián lěng de màncháng tànsuǒ. Xuézhě wèile nòngqīng yí ge lìshǐ xìjié, wǎngwǎng xūyào zài hàohàn rú yānhǎi de gǔjí zīliào zhōng fǎnfù sōuqiú, bǐduì kǎozhèng. Zhèng shì zài zhè yífènfèn fànhuáng de dàng'àn zīliào lǐ, lìshǐ nà móhu de miànpáng cái yìdiǎndiǎn biàn de qīngxī kě gǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Scholarship is a patient decade-long pursuit. To clarify a single historical detail, researchers sift through seas of ancient documents, comparing evidence. In these yellowed archival records, history's blurred face gradually becomes distinct.
extended_reading_passages.es: La investigación académica exige años de paciente estudio. Para esclarecer un pormenor histórico, el sabio escudriña legajos antiguos cotejando datos. Es en esa documentación amarillenta donde el rostro borroso del pasado cobra nitidez.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在数字化大数据时代，保护个人敏感资料与数据安全已上升为国家战略。相关法律法规严格规范互联网企业对用户个人信息资料的采集、存储与跨境传输行为，依法严厉打击非法买卖公民资料犯罪，全面筑牢数字经济时代的信息安全堤坝。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài shùzìhuà dàshùjù shídài, bǎohù gèrén mǐngǎn zīliào yǔ shùjù ānquán yǐ shàngshēng wéi guójiā zhànlüè. Xiāngguān fǎlǜ fǎguī yángé guīfàn hùliánwǎng qǐyè duì yònghù gèrén xìnxī zīliào de cǎijí, cúnchǔ yǔ kuàjìng chuánshū xíngwéi, yīfǎ yánlì dǎjī fēifǎ mǎimài gōngmín zīliào fànzuì, quánmiàn zhùláo shùzì jīngjì shídài de xìnxī ānquán dībà.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the big data era, protecting sensitive personal information has become a national strategy. Strict laws regulate collection, storage, and cross-border transfer of user data by tech firms, cracking down on illegal trafficking to fortify security.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la era de los macrodatos, proteger la información sensible es una prioridad nacional. Las leyes regulan la recogida y almacenamiento de datos por firmas tecnológicas y penalizan el tráfico de expedientes, blindando la seguridad digital.

meanings_summary.en: once; formerly; previously; at one time in the past
meanings_summary.es: una vez; antaño; en otro tiempo; anteriormente; haber ocurrido en el pasado

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: What has already elapsed in past days (曾) and passed through life's loom (经) happened previously (曾经).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Lo que ya transcurrió en días idos (曾) y pasó por el telar de la vida (经) ocurrió en otro tiempo (曾经).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: A time-aspect adverb dating to Middle Chinese; marks completed experiences situated in a bygone temporal frame, often evoking nostalgic or reflective emotional coloring.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising tone followed by level high tone: 'céng jīng' (35-55). Smooth rising contour on 'céng', followed by a sustained high tone on 'jīng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 曾经 is an aspectual adverb indicating that an event definitively took place in the past, often contrasting with the present.

contrasts.analysis: 已经 indicates that an action is currently completed ('已经做完'), whereas 曾经 emphasizes that it occurred in a bygone past period ('曾经做过').
从前 is a time noun meaning 'in the past / once upon a time', while 曾经 is an adverb directly preceding verbal predicates.
过去 functions as a broad noun for the past ('在过去') or directional verb, unlike the preverbal aspect marker 曾经.

etymological_cognates.gloss_en: former times; sun over dried meat
cross over; pass by on road

senses.definition_en: indicates that an action or state occurred or existed at a specific prior time in the past
senses.definition_es: indica que una acción o estado tuvo lugar o existió en un momento anterior del pasado
senses.example_phrase: 曾经去过北京 (once visited Beijing)

example_sentences.hanzi: 青年时代他曾经独自背着行囊周游大江南北，那些艰苦而充实的旅途岁月磨砺了他坚韧的性格。
example_sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián shídài tā céngjīng dúzì bēizhe xíngnáng zhōuyóu Dàjiāng-nánběi, nàxiē jiānkǔ ér chōngshí de lǚtú suìyuè mólì le tā jiānrèn de xìnggé.
example_sentences.en: In his youth he once traveled across the nation alone with a backpack; those arduous and fulfilling journeys honed his resilient character.
example_sentences.es: En su juventud recorrió en solitario el país con una mochila; aquellas duras y ricas andanzas templaron su tenaz personalidad.

example_sentences.hanzi: 鲁迅在给友人的信件中曾经深情形容故乡绍兴的乌篷船与社戏，那些童年水乡记忆是他一生的精神慰藉。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn zài gěi yǒurén de xìnjiàn zhōng céngjīng shēnqíng xíngróng gùxiāng Shàoxīng de wūpéngchuán yǔ shèxì, nàxiē tóngnián shuǐxiāng jìyì shì tā yìshēng de jīngshén wèijiè.
example_sentences.en: In letters to friends, Lu Xun once affectionately described the awning boats and village operas of Shaoxing, a lifelong spiritual comfort.
example_sentences.es: En cartas a amigos, Lu Xun evocó con cariño las barcas de toldo negro y las óperas de Shaoxing, recuerdos de infancia que fueron su consuelo vital.

collocations.en: having seen the wide sea (experienced much)

idioms.meaning_en: having sailed the vast ocean, other waters pale in comparison
time has passed and the circumstances have changed
things change with the passage of time
the present cannot be compared to the past; dramatic change

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram of a clay steaming cauldron with steam rising; borrowed phonetically to signify already passed time.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Steam rises into the air above the cauldron, marking past days (日) that have already elapsed (曾).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El vapor se eleva sobre la olla cocedora, simbolizando los días (日) ya transcurridos (曾).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where longitudinal silk threads 纟 run continuously through the loom, denoting passing through time.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Long silk threads (纟) pass through the loom from end to end, weaving experiences along the way (经).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Finos hilos de seda (纟) atraviesan el telar de principio a fin, tejiendo el paso del tiempo (经).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 曾经走过的弯路与吃过的苦头，最终都会化作生命中最珍贵的养分。那些在至暗时刻咬牙坚持的岁月，如今回望起来不过是轻舟已过的万重山峦。不必沉溺于过去的遗憾，所有曾经的磨难，都是为了成全今日更坚韧的自己。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Céngjīng zǒuguò de wānlù yǔ chīguò de kǔtou, zuìzhōng dōu huì huàzuò shēngmìng zhōng zuì zhēnguì de yǎngfèn. Nàxiē zài zhì'àn shíkè yǎoyá jiānchí de suìyuè, rújīn huíwàng qǐlái bùguò shì qīngzhōu-yǐguò de wànchóng shānluán. Búbì chénnì yú guòqù de yíhàn, suǒyǒu céngjīng de mónàn, dōu shì wèile chéngquán jīnrì gèng jiānrèn de zìjǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: The detours and hardships once endured ultimately become life's richest nutrients. Dark hours endured with grit now seem like distant mountains passed by a swift boat. Regret not the past; all trials forge a stronger self.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los desvíos y sinsabores vividos antaño terminan siendo el mejor abono del alma. Las horas aciagas resistidas con coraje parecen hoy cumbres lejanas dejadas atrás. No cabe llorar el ayer: las pruebas sufridas forjan la entereza presente.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 回首近代以来中华民族走过的风雨征程，无数仁人志士曾经为了救亡图存抛头颅洒热血。从积贫积弱的半殖民地旧中国，到今日繁荣昌盛的世界第二大经济体，这片古老大地上曾经饱经沧桑的历史记忆，始终激励着亿万中华儿女奋勇前行。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Huíshǒu jìndài yǐlái Zhōnghuá mínzú zǒuguò de fēngyǔ zhēngchéng, wúshù rénrén-zhìshì céngjīng wèile jiùwáng-túcún pāotóu-sǎrèxuè. Cóng jīpín-jīruò de bàn zhímíndì jiù Zhōngguó, dào jīnrì fánróng-chāngshèng de shìjiè dì-èr dà jīngjìtǐ, zhè piàn gǔlǎo dàdì shàng céngjīng bǎojīng-cāngsāng de lìshǐ jìyì, shǐzhōng jīlì zhe yìwàn Zhōnghuá érnǚ fènyǒng qiánxíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Looking back on modern trials, patriots once shed blood to save the nation. From a broken semi-colony to the world's second-largest economy, memories of hardship once endured on this soil inspire millions to advance boldly.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al contemplar las vicisitudes de la era moderna, incontables patriotas dieron su sangre por la nación. De la humillación colonial al vigor de la segunda potencia económica, las penalidades sufridas antaño alientan a avanzar con tesón.

meanings_summary.en: to describe; to depict; to portray; appearance; countenance
meanings_summary.es: describir; retratar; calificar; semblante; apariencia física

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Observe external shapes (形) and facial countenance (容) to vividly describe and portray reality (形容).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Observa la figura externa (形) y el semblante (容) para describir la realidad con maestría (形容).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Originally denoted a person's physical demeanor and facial looks ('xíngtài róngmào'); in classical rhetoric it shifted into using verbal similes to capture essence.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two rising tones: 'xíng róng' (35-35). Two steady parallel rising glides from mid to high pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 形容 emphasizes using verbal metaphors, adjectives, or analogies to portray physical appearance or sensory experience.

contrasts.analysis: 描写 denotes systematic literary prose depicting scenes or actions in extended paragraphs, while 形容 is frequently used for concise qualitative analogies ('用...来形容').
描述 is a formal, objective verb for narrating facts or procedural details ('描述事故经过'), whereas 形容 emphasizes figurative imagery.
形容 is a verb (to describe), whereas 形象 is primarily a noun (image/figure) or adjective (vivid/graphic).

example_sentences.hanzi: 站在巍峨的雪山之巅，面对日照金山的壮丽奇观，那种震撼的心情简直无法用言语来形容。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhàn zài wéi'é de xuěshān zhī diān, miànduì rìzhào-jīnshān de zhuànglì qíguān, nà zhǒng zhènhàn de xīnqíng jiǎnzhí wúfǎ yòng yányǔ lái xíngróng.
example_sentences.en: Standing atop the snow-capped peak before the golden sunrise, that awe-inspiring emotion simply defies verbal description.
example_sentences.es: En la cumbre de la montaña nevada ante el amanecer dorado, la honda emoción que sentí resulta imposible de describir con palabras.

example_sentences.hanzi: 郁达夫曾撰文形容鲁迅先生的相貌与风度：“醉眼朦胧，悠悠自得”，生动勾勒出鲁迅文人生活的一面。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yù Dáfū céng zhuànwén xíngróng Lǔ Xùn xiānsheng de xiàngmào yǔ fēngdù: 'zuìyǎn ménglóng, yōuyōu zìdé', shēngdòng gōulè chū Lǔ Xùn wénrén shēnghuó de yí miàn.
example_sentences.en: Yu Dafu once described Mr. Lu Xun's countenance: 'eyes hazy from wine, leisurely and content', vividly sketching his literati lifestyle.
example_sentences.es: Yu Dafu describió la traza de Lu Xun: 'ojos entornados por el vino, plácido y dueño de sí', retratando con viveza su temple letrado.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Delicate brushstrokes (彡) trace out the physical contours and visible shape (形) of an object.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Trazos de pincel (彡) dibujan los contornos y la figura visible (形) de un cuerpo.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Under the roof (宀), a serene valley (谷) accommodates all things, reflecting peaceful facial countenance (容).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Bajo el alero (宀), el amplio valle (谷) acoge los arroyos, reflejando el rostro sereno (容).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 大自然造化之美，往往超越了人类语言形容的极限。黄昏时分夕阳熔金，漫天晚霞将整片海面染成了瑰丽的紫红色，波光潋滟美不胜收。面对如此雄奇壮丽的天地大美，任何华丽的修辞都显得苍白无力，唯有静默赞叹。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Dàzìrán zàohuà zhī měi, wǎngwǎng chāoyuè le rénlèi yǔyán xíngróng de jíxiàn. Huánghūn shífēn xīyáng róngjīn, màntiān wǎnxiá jiāng zhěng piàn hǎimiàn rǎnchéng le guīlì de zǐhóngsè, bōguāng-liànyàn měibùshèngshōu. Miànduì rúcǐ xióngqí zhuànglì de tiāndì dàměi, rènhé huálì de xiūcí dōu xiǎnde cāngbái-wúlì, wéiyǒu jìngmò zàntàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Nature's beauty often exceeds the limits of human description. At dusk, melting golden sunsets dye the entire sea in magnificent violet. Facing such grand splendor, any ornate rhetoric pales; only reverent silence remains.
extended_reading_passages.es: La creación natural desborda los límites de la descripción humana. Al crepúsculo, el sol poniente tiñe las olas de un púrpura fastuoso. Ante tanta majestuosidad, cualquier retórica resulta vana y solo cabe el silencio extasiado.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 优秀的文学家总能以独特的洞察力提炼出生动传神的比喻。在现代文学经典名篇中，鲁迅以“风马牛不相及”形容世态的冷漠隔阂，用“路是人走出来的”形象激励青年勇于开拓。这些贴切生动的形容，具有穿越时代的永恒艺术生命力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yōuxiù de wénxuéjiā zǒng néng yǐ dútè de dòngchálì tíliàn chū shēngdòng chuánshén de bǐyù. Zài xiàndài wénxué jīngdiǎn míngpiān zhōng, Lǔ Xùn yǐ 'fēngmǎniú bù xiāng jí' xíngróng shìtài de lěngmò géhé, yòng 'lù shì rén zǒuchūlái de' xíngxiàng jīlì qīngnián yǒngyú kāituò. Zhèxiē tiēqiè shēngdòng de xíngróng, jùyǒu chuānyuè shídài de yǒnghéng yìshù shēngmìnglì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Master authors extract vivid metaphors with keen insight. In classic essays, Lu Xun described social indifference with pungent sayings and encouraged youth by writing 'paths are made by walking'. Such apt descriptions possess timeless vitality.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los grandes literatos forjan metáforas imborrables. En sus clásicos, Lu Xun calificó la frialdad social con mordaces símiles y exhortó a los jóvenes recordando que el camino se hace al andar. Tales descripciones atesoran vigencia eterna.

meanings_summary.en: hazy; dim; obscure; misty; blurred (from wine, mist, or twilight)
meanings_summary.es: brumoso; borroso; tenue; velado; difuso; soñoliento

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When the moon is shrouded by clouds (朦) and drifts like a twilight dragon (胧), the landscape turns hazy and dim (朦胧).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando la luna queda velada (朦) y serpentea en la penumbra (胧), el paisaje se torna brumoso y difuso (朦胧).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: A celebrated aesthetic term in classical Chinese poetry; 'ménglóng' values evocative poetic indeterminacy ('朦胧诗') over stark, clinical clarity.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two rising tones: 'méng lóng' (35-35). Two gentle, continuous upward sweeps capturing the soft, indistinct imagery.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 朦胧 characterizes a soft, aesthetically pleasing indistinctness caused by moonlight, mist, sleep, or mild wine.

contrasts.analysis: 模糊 is an everyday, technical term for blurred vision, damaged lenses, or indistinct logic, whereas 朦胧 carries strong poetic, evocative beauty.
隐约 can describe both faint sights and distant sounds ('隐约听到'), while 朦胧 predominantly describes visual twilight, mist, or mental haze.
明晰 (crystal clear and sharply defined) is the direct antonym of 朦胧.

example_sentences.hanzi: 清晨薄雾笼罩着湖畔，远处的亭台楼阁与垂柳在朦胧的水汽中若隐若现，宛如水墨仙境。
example_sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén báowù lǒngzhào zhe húpàn, yuǎnchù de tíngtái-lóugé yǔ chuíliǔ zài ménglóng de shuǐqì zhōng ruòyǐn-ruòxiàn, wǎnrú shuǐmò xiānjìng.
example_sentences.en: Morning mist enshrouded the lakeshore; distant pavilions and willows faded in and out in hazy vapor like an ink-wash dreamland.
example_sentences.es: La neblina matinal cubría la orilla; quioscos y sauces llorones asomaban entre el vaho brumoso como una acuarela de hadas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 友人撰文回忆鲁迅宴饮时的神采，称他酒过三巡后“醉眼朦胧”，神情极为亲切和蔼，尽显文人真性情。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yǒurén zhuànwén huíyì Lǔ Xùn yànyǐn shí de shéncǎi, chēng tā jiǔguò-sānxún hòu 'zuìyǎn ménglóng', shénqíng jíwéi qīnqiè hé'ǎi, jìnxiǎn wénrén zhēnxìngqíng.
example_sentences.en: Friends recalled Lu Xun's demeanor after wine: 'eyes hazy from drink', warmly amiable, revealing his genuine literati nature.
example_sentences.es: Sus amigos recordaban a Lu Xun tras brindar varias rondas: con los ojos entornados y brumosos, cordial y mostrando su genio más franco.

collocations.en: eyes dim and hazy with wine

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where the moon 月 is obscured and covered 蒙 by drifting mist and night clouds.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The pale moon (月) is wrapped in covered veils of cloud (蒙), shedding dim, hazy light (朦).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La pálida luna (月) queda envuelta bajo velos de nubes (蒙), emitiendo una luz tenue y brumosa (朦).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where the nocturnal moon 月 shines indistinctly like a dragon 龙 concealed in clouds.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The nocturnal crescent moon (月) drifts like a dragon (龙) through misty night fog, creating twilight (胧).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La luna creciente (月) serpentea como un dragón (龙) entre la niebla nocturna creando un halo difuso (胧).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 江南春夜，月色朦胧。细雨初歇的石板路上倒映着点点红灯笼的光晕，乌篷船在桨声灯影里悠然摇曳。古镇在湿润的水汽中半睡半醒，那种若即若离的朦胧诗意，宛如一幅晕染开来的宋代山水长卷，令人沉醉不知归路。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jiāngnán chūnyè, yuèxiè ménglóng. Xìyǔ chū xiē de shíbǎnlù shàng dàoyìng zhe diǎndiǎn hóng dēnglong de guāngyùn, wūpéngchuán zài jiǎngshēng-dēngyǐng lǐ yōurán yáoyè. Gǔzhèn zài shīrùn de shuǐqì zhōng bànshuì-bànxǐng, nà zhǒng ruòjí-ruòlí de ménglóng shīyì, wǎnrú yì fú yùnrǎn kāilái de Sòngdài shānshuǐ chángjuàn, lìngrén chénzuì bùzhī guīlù.
extended_reading_passages.en: On a spring night south of the Yangtze, the moon shines hazy. Lantern glows shimmer on wet stone paths as awning boats sway. Half-awake in mist, the ancient town's poetic haze intoxicates like a Song landscape scroll.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la noche primaveral del sur, la luna brilla tenue. Los farolillos rojos se reflejan en el empedrado mientras las barcas se mecen. Entre la bruma húmeda, el pueblo antiguo destila una poesía que embriaga como un lienzo Song.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在二十世纪七八十年代的中国诗坛上，“朦胧诗”派以其独特的艺术探索开创了现代诗歌的新纪元。诗人通过多义性的意象组合与富有哲思的意境留白，打破了传统现实主义诗歌单一说教的僵化模式，唤醒了无数读者对于人性、尊严与独立思考的深刻觉醒。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài èrshí shìjì qībāshí niándài de Zhōngguó shītán shàng, 'Ménglóngshī' pài yǐ qí dútè de yìshù tànsuǒ kāichuàng le xiàndài shīgē de xīn jìyuán. Shīrén tōngguò duōyìxìng de yìxiàng zǔhé yǔ fùyǒu zhésī de yìjìng liúbái, dǎpò le chuántǒng xiànshí zhǔyì shīgē dānyī shuōjiào de jiānghuà móshì, huànxǐng le wúshù dúzhě duìyú rénxìng, zūnyán yǔ dúlì sīkǎo de shēnkè juéxǐng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In late 20th-century Chinese poetry, the 'Misty Poets' opened a new era through artistic exploration. Multi-layered imagery and reflective spaces shattered rigid didacticism, awakening readers to human dignity and independent thought.
extended_reading_passages.es: La corriente de la 'Poesía Brumosa' inauguró una nueva era en las letras chinas. Sus metáforas polisémicas y silencios meditados rompieron el didactismo monolítico, despertando la dignidad humana y el pensamiento crítico en millones de lectores.

meanings_summary.en: leisurely; unhurried; lingering; protracted; long-drawn-out; endless (of time)
meanings_summary.es: apacible; sosegado; parsimonioso; prolongado; interminable; milenario

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A calm, unhurried heart duplicated twice (悠悠) floats leisurely across vast expanses of time (悠悠).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un corazón sosegado repetido dos veces (悠悠) flota con parsimonia a través del tiempo milenario (悠悠).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: A classical poetic reduplication found in the Book of Songs (诗经: '青青子衿，悠悠我心'); conveys the lingering emotional resonance of longing, leisurely contentment, and deep historical time.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two high level tones: 'yōu yōu' (55-55). Sustained, steady high plateau pitch capturing peaceful, prolonged flow.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 悠悠 describes the unhurried, peaceful tempo of life, or the vast, lingering passage of historical time and musical echoes.

contrasts.analysis: 悠闲 strictly describes an individual's leisurely lifestyle or relaxed mood, while 悠悠 can describe lingering sounds, vast centuries ('悠悠万事'), or drifting clouds.
漫长 emphasizes lengthy, tedious duration ('漫长的等待'), while 悠悠 carries poetic, nostalgic, and serene grace.
匆匆 (hurried and rushed in haste) is the direct semantic antonym of 悠悠.

senses.definition_en: leisurely, relaxed, slow, and completely free from rush or anxiety
senses.definition_es: sosegado, tranquilo, pausado y sin prisas ni agobios
senses.example_phrase: 闲情悠悠 (leisurely and carefree mood)

senses.definition_en: long, protracted, or lingering continuously across vast expanses of time or space
senses.definition_es: prolongado, interminable o milenario a través de eras remotas o distancias
senses.example_phrase: 悠悠岁月 (the long, lingering years)

example_sentences.hanzi: 山间古寺钟声悠悠回荡在云雾缭绕的峡谷之中，洗涤着红尘过客心头的浮躁与疲惫。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shānjiān gǔsì zhōngshēng yōuyōu huídàng zài yúnwù-liáorào de xiágǔ zhīzhōng, xǐdí zhe hóngchén guòkè xīntóu de fúzào yǔ píbèi.
example_sentences.en: The bell of the mountain temple echoed leisurely and lingeringly in the mist-veiled canyon, washing away travelers' restless fatigue.
example_sentences.es: La campana del templo serrano resonaba con pausado eco en el cañón cubierto de niebla, lavando las fatigas del caminante.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在老友郁达夫笔下，鲁迅饮酒微醺时有着“悠悠自得”的神态，那是严峻斗士卸下防备后最本真的文人风骨。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài lǎoyǒu Yù Dáfū bǐxià, Lǔ Xùn yǐnjiǔ wēixūn shí yǒuzhe 'yōuyōu-zìdé' de shéntài, nà shì yánjùn dòushì xièxià fángbèi hòu zuì běnzhēn de wénrén fēnggǔ.
example_sentences.en: In friend Yu Dafu's words, when Lu Xun was slightly tipsy he wore an unhurried, content air, the authentic grace of a warrior letting down his guard.
example_sentences.es: En la pluma de Yu Dafu, Lu Xun lucía un porte sosegado al brindar, revelando la entraña franca del luchador que desciende la guardia.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character combining heart 心 with 攸 (flowing calm water), denoting an unruffled, relaxed soul and lingering distance.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A calm heart (心) flows like gentle unhurried water (攸), resting in peaceful leisure and lingering time (悠).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un corazón sereno (心) fluye como agua mansa (攸), descansando en dulce sosiego y tiempo prolongado (悠).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 放慢匆忙的脚步，才能听见生活悠悠流淌的清音。坐在老藤椅上泡一盏淡茶，看庭前落花随风起舞，天边白云悠悠远去。不必焦虑未来的风雨，在这份不慌不忙的从容里，灵魂方能重获久违的安顿与宁静。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Fàngmàn cōngmáng de jiǎobù, cáinéng tīngjiàn shēnghuó yōuyōu liútǎng de qīngyīn. Zuò zài lǎoténgyǐ shàng pào yì zhǎn dànchá, kàn tíngqián luòhuā suífēng qǐwǔ, tiānbiān báiyún yōuyōu yuǎnqù. Búbì jiāolǜ wèilái de fēngyǔ, zài zhè fèn bùhuāng-bùmáng de cóngróng lǐ, línghún fāng néng chónghuò jiǔwéi de āndùn yǔ níngjìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Slowing rushed footsteps allows one to hear life's gentle melody. Sipping tea in a rattan chair, watching fallen flowers dance and clouds drift afar, anxieties fade as the soul regains peace in unhurried composure.
extended_reading_passages.es: Frenar las prisas permite escuchar el rumor apacible de la vida. En una mecedora con té tibio, viendo bailar las flores y pasar nubes lentas, se disipan los desvelos y el alma recobra su sosiego soñado.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 五千年华夏文明历经悠悠岁月的洗礼，展现出坚韧不拔的强大生命力。从甲骨青铜的深邃记忆，到唐诗宋词的绝美华章，滚滚长江东逝水淘尽千古风流，唯有那份深植于血脉深处的文化自信，在历史长河中历久弥新、生生不息。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wǔqiān nián Huáxià wénmíng lìjīng yōuyōu suìyuè de xǐlǐ, zhǎnxiàn chū jiānrèn-bùbá de qiángdà shēngmìnglì. Cóng jiǎgǔ-qīngtóng de shēnsuì jìyì, dào Tángshī-Sòngcí de juéměi huázhāng, gǔngǔn Chángjiāng dōng shì shuǐ táojìn qiāngǔ fēngliú, wéiyǒu nà fèn shēnzhí yú xuèmài shēnchù de wénhuà zìxìn, zài lìshǐ chánghé zhōng lìjiǔ-míxīn, shēngshēng-bùxī.
extended_reading_passages.en: Tested by lingering millennia, five thousand years of Chinese civilization reveal enduring vigor. From oracle bronzes to Tang and Song poetry, though rivers wash away heroes, deep cultural confidence remains immortal and vibrant.
extended_reading_passages.es: A lo largo de eras milenarias, la civilización china muestra una recia vitalidad. De los bronces arcaicos a la lírica de Tang y Song, aunque las aguas del Yangtsé arrastren héroes, la confianza cultural florece perenne.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Combine physical form (形) with the vivid iconic presence of the elephant (象) to build a powerful image (形象).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Aúna la forma física (形) con la figura elocuente del elefante (象) para forjar una imagen vívida (形象).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: According to Han Feizi, ancient Chinese rarely saw living elephants, so they imagined their shape by studying elephant bones (见其骨而象之); thus 'xiàng' became the root for mental images, symbols, and metaphors.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising tone followed by falling tone: 'xíng xiàng' (35-51). Syllable 'xíng' glides upward, followed by a crisp descending drop on 'xiàng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 形象 denotes public reputational image, artistic fictional character, or functions as an adjective meaning vivid and graphic.

contrasts.analysis: 现象 refers to objective natural or societal occurrences and manifestations ('自然现象'), while 形象 refers to personal reputational persona or vivid metaphor.
印象 is the subjective impression left in someone's memory ('第一印象'), whereas 形象 is the objective persona projected outwards.
生动 emphasizes dynamic lifelikeness and animated charm, while 形象 as an adjective emphasizes clear, graphic metaphorical representation.

senses.definition_es: imagen pública, figura artística, semblanza moral o prestigio corporativo
senses.example_phrase: 树立良好形象 (establish a good public image)

senses.definition_es: gráfico, vívido, plástico y expresivo al ilustrar conceptos con metáforas
senses.example_phrase: 比喻非常形象 (the metaphor is extremely vivid)

example_sentences.hanzi: 老师用切苹果的分数比喻深入浅出，十分形象地解释了抽象的数学原理，让同学们豁然开朗。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng qiē píngguǒ de fēnshù bǐyù shēnrù-qiǎnchū, shífēn xíngxiàng de jiěshì le chōuxiàng de shùxué yuánlǐ, ràng tóngxuémen huòrán-kāilǎng.
example_sentences.en: Using sliced apples to illustrate fractions, the teacher explained abstract principles vividly, enlightening the students.
example_sentences.es: El maestro explicó principios matemáticos abstractos mediante un elocuente símil con manzanas cortadas, iluminando a los alumnos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在现代读者心中，鲁迅先生往往被塑造成金刚怒目的斗士形象，但研读其日常书信，才能触摸到一个有血有肉的完整鲁迅。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài xiàndài dúzhě xīnzhōng, Lǔ Xùn xiānsheng wǎngwǎng bèi sùzào chéng jīngāng-nùmù de dòushì xíngxiàng, dàn yándú qí rìcháng shūxìn, cáinéng chùmō dào yí ge yǒuxuè-yǒuròu de wánzhěng Lǔ Xùn.
example_sentences.en: To modern readers, Lu Xun is often cast as an uncompromising warrior; yet reading his letters reveals a complete, flesh-and-blood human being.
example_sentences.es: Los lectores suelen imaginar a Lu Xun como un combatiente de ceño adusto; mas al leer su correspondencia se descubre a un ser entrañable de carne y hueso.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where elegant brushstrokes 彡 trace out the outer shape of an entity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Fine brushstrokes (彡) define the physical form and visible silhouette (形) of a living figure.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Trazos de pincel (彡) dibujan la figura externa y la silueta visible (形) de un ser.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 象 (ancient oracle bone pictogram of an elephant)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Oracle bone pictogram of an elephant with long trunk, large ears, and stout body; extended to the concept of form, mental image, and phenomenon.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An elephant with curved trunk and stout body outlines a grand iconic mental image (象).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un elefante de larga trompa y cuerpo robusto perfila una imagen icónica y palpable (象).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 一个人的外在形象，是其内在涵养与精神风貌的直观投射。得体的谈吐、沉稳的举止与真诚的眼神，往往胜过一切华丽的名牌包装。保持干净大方的个人形象，不仅是对他人的基本尊重，更是对自己人格尊严的郑重守护。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yí ge rén de wàizài xíngxiàng, shì qí nèizài hányǎng yǔ jīngshén fēngmào de zhíguān tóushè. Détǐ de tántǔ, chénwěn de jǔzhǐ yǔ zhēnchéng de yǎnshén, wǎngwǎng shèngguò yíqiè huálì de míngpái bāozhuāng. Bǎochí gānjìng-dàfang de gèrén xíngxiàng, bùjǐn shì duì tārén de jīběn zūnzhòng, gèng shì duì zìjǐ réngé zūnyán de zhèngzhòng shǒuhù.
extended_reading_passages.en: Personal image is a direct reflection of inner culture. Proper speech, steady posture, and sincere eyes outweigh luxury packaging. Maintaining a clean, dignified image respects others and solemnly guards one's own dignity.
extended_reading_passages.es: La imagen exterior proyecta el cultivo interior y la compostura. El hablar mesurado, el porte firme y la mirada limpia superan a las marcas de lujo. Guardar una traza pulcra y cabal honra al prójimo y protege la propia dignidad.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国国家形象的全球传播正在从宏大叙事转向具象生动的人文表达。纪录片与影视出海团队通过聚焦当代普通中国人的奋斗打拼与温情日常，将古老东方的深厚底蕴生动具象化。这种真实接地气的文化形象，有效增进了全球民心相通。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó guójiā xíngxiàng de quánqiú chuánbō zhèngzài cóng hóngdà xùshì zhuǎnxiàng jùxiàng shēngdòng de rénwén biǎodá. Jìlùpiàn yǔ yǐngshì chūhǎi tuánduì tōngguò jùjiāo dāngdài pǔtōng Zhōngguórén de fèndòu dǎpīn yǔ wēnqíng rìcháng, jiāng gǔlǎo dōngfāng de shēnhòu dǐyùn shēngdòng jùxiànghuà. Zhè zhǒng zhēnshí jiēdìqì de wénhuà xíngxiàng, yǒuxiào zēngjìn le quánqiú mínxīn-xiāngtōng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Global communication of national image is shifting from grand narratives to human stories. Documentaries focusing on ordinary lives embody eastern heritage concretely. This grounded cultural image fosters international mutual understanding.
extended_reading_passages.es: La proyección internacional de la imagen de China evoluciona hacia historias humanas y vivas. Al mostrar la brega cotidiana de ciudadanos corrientes, se visibiliza el arraigo oriental. Esa imagen franca y humana tiende puentes entre las gentes.
